### test_asr_verbs.das

every lane tag a family the facade loads by image registers routes to that family: a lane `asr_image_route` misses panics a `.dlim` load by path

- `test_asr_image_routes` - asr_image_route maps every lane tag the six ASR families register to its family, with at least two lanes a family as the sweep control, and routes chat-tower and unregistered lanes nowhere
- `test_gigaam_detokenize` - gigaam_detokenize over toy vocabs joins charwise pieces verbatim, and in SPM mode turns the mark into a space, drops the leading one and renders control pieces as nothing
- `test_asr_default_lang` - asr_default_lang picks the single listed language, auto for an empty list and English for several, and the GigaAM caps sheet resolves to ru
- `test_gigaam_check_lang` - gigaam_check_lang accepts ru, the empty string and auto without a panic, and panics on en with a message naming Russian (ru)
- `test_family_exec_fmt_verbs` - Each ASR family exec_fmt verb, fed hand-set model structs, stamps the exact precision string for its q8, f32, f16 and K-quant lane flags
- `test_gpu_lane_seat_exact_ask` - gpu_exact_serves follows the serves hook when no exact ask is set, and an exact ask answering false or a non-serving seat stands the exact lane down to the q8 image
- `test_audio_lane_knobs` - Each audio family q8 lane defaults to its policy, a pin flips it either way and reset returns to the policy, and the ASR decoder K/V dtype defaults to f16 and reads back its setter
- `test_audio_lane_env` - In child processes DASLLAMA_AUDIO_LANE=8 or 16 moves every un-pinned audio family to that lane while API pins still win and the lane lines name the knob; unset or a bad value leaves the policy lanes
- `test_family_encode_buckets` - Each ASR family encode-total profiler bucket is its pinned name, and the facade asr_encode_bucket answers the same bucket for every AsrKind
- `test_asr_device_lane_names_home` - asr_device_lane for a parakeet or gigaam model names the GPU home its image is flavored for, cpu for an unflavored image and for gigaam where its GPU driver does not serve
- `test_tower_kq_source_conversion` - Over synthetic GGUFs a quantized non-Q8_0 audio tensor keeps the CUDA flavor and the load says one conversion line naming the type, member and lane form, while Q8_0, float and non-audio sources say none
- `test_tower_lane_helpers` - The halfword-lane helpers stage the exact pick as f16 on every GPU home and never the q8 pick or the CPU flavor, and tower_load_f16 reads a .dlim by its baked lane tag over the caller flavor
- `test_parakeet_detokenize` - parakeet_detokenize strips the spaces of the first piece SPM marks but keeps them on later pieces, passes unmarked pieces through, drops control pieces and maps no tokens to the empty string

### test_attn_span.das

- `test_attn_span` - On stories15M a causal prefill keeps row 0 bit-blind to a last-row perturbation while the non-causal span lets it see it on f32 and q4_0, flash agrees with classic within 1e-2, and a later causal prefill is bit-exact
- `test_mrope_span` - The mrope span quantum gives bit-exact fused and spliced decode logits, sets rope_pos_delta to max grid minus span rows, and its grid positions and grid shape both change the logits
- `test_attn_span_fused` - The fused mid-turn span eval leaves the same cache as the three-eval splice (bit-exact decode logits on classic, within 1e-2 on flash) and in one eval keeps head rows causal while span rows see each other
- `test_attn_span_guards` - Inverted or foreign span bounds and a recurrent graph panic the prefill, a split-span override sees three calls and a fused one one, and an override without the mrope or deepstack seat is never asked
- `test_deepstack_rail` - Deepstack wide rows with zero tails match the narrow eval bit-exact, nonzero tail slices move the logits at slice-dependent depths, and a following text eval sees no stale plane

### test_batch_decode.das

- `test_batch_decode_fp32` - eval_batch_ over three ragged stories15M prompts with fp32 weights and f32 KV reproduces each sequential stream logits and final caches within 1e-6, while another row reference lands outside the bar
- `test_batch_decode_q8` - With Q8_0 weights on the portable backend, batched decode reproduces the sequential per-step logits and final KV caches of three ragged prompts within 1e-6, a cross-row control outside the bar
- `test_batch_decode_hybrid` - On the Qwen3.5 deltanet hybrid and its MoE sibling, every batched step runs on the CPU stack and matches sequential logits, KV, deltanet state and conv history within 1e-6, and decoding below the deltanet position panics
- `test_batch_decode_f16_kv` - Under the f16 KV codec with Q8_0 stories15M weights, batched decode reproduces the sequential per-step logits and decoded final caches within 1e-6, a cross-row control outside the bar
- `test_batch_decode_q8_kv` - Under the q8_0 KV codec on SmolLM2-135M, batched decode reproduces the sequential per-step logits and dequantized final caches within 1e-6, a cross-row control outside the bar
- `test_batch_decode_tq4_kv` - Under the tq4 KV codec on SmolLM2-135M, batched decode reproduces the sequential per-step logits and dequantized final caches within 1e-6, a cross-row control outside the bar
- `test_batch_decode_q4` - With Q4_0 weights every batched step runs on the CPU batched stack and reproduces the sequential greedy tokens, logits and caches bit-exact, since the batched GEMM is the GEMV dot over rows
- `test_batch_decode_step_census` - batch_step_census counts each two-row eval_batch_ step on the CPU batched stack with none per-row or on a device, and a one-row step as per-row only
- `test_batch_decode_row_refuses_per_row` - The batched bench row serves at a positive rate on the CPU batched stack, and with the classic rope path forcing per-row steps it refuses by name, reads 0 and the census counts the per-row steps
- `test_batch_decode_b1_delegation` - A one-row eval_batch_ delegates to forward, so its six greedy tokens, logits and final caches match the sequential stream bit for bit
- `test_batch_decode_shrink` - After the middle row retires mid-run, the two surviving batched rows keep their sequential greedy tokens, logits within 1e-6 and final caches within 1e-6
- `test_batch_decode_tuned` - On the box best kernel backend with no pin, batched decode fed the sequential tokens keeps per-step logits and final caches within 1e-3 of the sequential stream, a cross-row control outside the bar
- `test_batch_decode_late_embed` - A batch override that declines every step, with its gather gate on or off, leaves the host embedding each row once and the CPU stack reading the plain batched step logits bit for bit
- `test_batch_decode_verify_declines` - verify_batch_groups declines an empty group, a group past the context, mixed K/V codecs and a flat beside a paged group before reaching the override, while two valid groups reach it

### test_bench_records_schema.das

- `test_write_reports_failure` - Writing a record store to an unopenable path (a directory) returns false from both the text writer and the typed write_bench_records, never a silent partial write
- `test_asr_round_trip` - ASR-shaped das and reference runs round-trip the JSON store with workload, per-clip ms and audio_s, files, versions, noise, parity and the das-only release counter intact
- `test_tts_round_trip` - A TTS cell das and mlx-audio rows round-trip the store under one test key with their ms and audio_s, and a TTS row and an LLM row of one model and leg upsert as two rows
- `test_upsert_workload_key` - upsert_bench_run keys on workload: an LLM and an audio-chat run sharing box, engine, backend and flavor stay two rows, and a re-measure of the same workload replaces in place
- `test_annotations` - apply_annotations lands a model-level note on the model and an engine-scoped comment only on the selected run, and an annotation for an absent gguf lands nowhere
- `test_oracle_compare` - oracle_compare is one-sided with a warn band: small drift is ok, -4% warns, -6% fails, a +10% gain stays ok but is flagged suspicious, and a missing or tok/s-less stored test fails
- `test_asr_catalog_invariants` - The ASR catalog holds no untraceable clip, marks exactly the chat models audio-chat, matches metal_served to the pinned Metal-rail roster, and carries LibriSpeech on one model
- `test_optional_fields_round_trip` - The optional encode_ms, void_clips, remote_desktop hardware stamp and comment fields survive a write and re-read of the record store
- `test_process_listed` - executable_in matches a listing line by executable file name, skips the excepted path and lines that merely mention the name, and the live process_listed finds the running executable
- `test_void_clips_annotation_lands` - An engine-scoped annotation carrying void_clips voids that clip on the selected reference run only, leaving the das run untouched
- `test_list_record_stores_strictness` - list_record_stores admits only a plain box .json store, rejecting tune sidecars, annotations.json, underscore-prefixed scratch and non-json files
- `test_das_run_unstamped` - das_run_unstamped flags a das run missing either the tune or tune_sha stamp, clears it when both are present, and never flags a reference run
- `test_workload_scope` - workload_scope maps all, llm, asr, image and tts to their pinned llm, asr, image and tts cell sets, with llm also taking image, and rejects an unknown or empty workload
- `test_stored_row_leg` - stored_row_leg resolves metal/tuned, cpu/tuned and cpu/accel to their rig legs and refuses every other backend and flavor pair, leaving no stale leg behind
- `test_image_chat_rows_pin_the_fixture` - Every committed image-chat row in the record stores has a cmd receipt naming bench_image_fixture and passing an mmproj, and the sweep finds at least one such row
- `test_batched_rows_carry_the_leg_shape` - Every committed batched row receipt carries its leg shape: GPU legs the flat 512-token shape with no cpu-only flag, cpu legs the 128 x 3 shape, and --no-op-offload on the stock cpu arm alone
- `test_parse_mtmd_image` - parse_mtmd_image sums the encode lines, splits prefill off MTMD_TIMING and carries the position counts, and refuses output missing the encode line, the timing line or the counts
- `test_parse_llama_batched_bench` - llama_batched_bench_tg reads the S_TG cell of the row at the asked npl and 0 for a missing row, table or numeric cell, and the batched reference row appends the leg arms and reads 0 with a reason for a dead exe
- `test_mtmd_versions_bin_param` - mtmd_versions stamps the llama.cpp engine name and the mtmd-timing patch tag for any bin argument, including a non-git path and the default CPU reference build
- `test_marian_reference_stamp` - marian_bin resolves the marian-decoder under the checkout inference build, and marian_versions stamps the checkout plus both patch hashes, or nothing without a checkout
- `test_image_ref_flag_invariants` - Every committed llama.cpp image-chat row carries -ngl 0 and --no-mmproj-offload exactly when it is labeled cpu, and --no-op-offload only on the stock cpu arm
- `test_das_rows_cite_archived_generations` - Every committed das row carrying a tune_sha cites a generation whose .tune archive is committed beside the record stores, and the sweep finds stamped rows
- `test_parse_mtmd_image_refusals` - parse_mtmd_image refuses a zero prefill wall, a counts-only timing line and an encode line with no number, and skips an untagged prose line in favor of the MTMD_TIMING one
- `test_sibling_mtmd` - sibling_mtmd answers the empty string for an empty llama-bench path and for one with no llama-mtmd-cli beside it, never a dead path
- `test_held_annotation_lands` - An engine-scoped annotation held field lands only on the selected das run, not the reference run, and round-trips the record store
- `test_audio_outlier_rule` - audio_outlier_clips flags a clip whose rate is past the multiple of the run median and none on an even or two-clip run, and a stored run is rated over the das row clip lengths
- `test_void_outlier_pass` - void_outlier_clips re-measures only the flagged clip once, voids it when the re-measure stays off, clears it when the re-measure lands inside the run, and re-measures nothing on an even run

### test_box_ident.das

- `test_wmi_answers` - WMI answer parsing keeps Key=value lines across wmic and CIM endings, reads a key value on the first equals sign only, sums RAM modules, and the CIM script spells the stand-in query exactly
- `test_box_probes` - A cgroup limit reads to whole GiB with no-limit and malformed spellings as 0, Linux RAM takes the v2 then v1 limit when under MemTotal, and this box live probes report a CPU brand and nonzero RAM

### test_box_profile.das

- `test_runtime_section_applies` - apply_box_profile_runtime sets every CPU runtime knob in a sidecar runtime section to its written value, read back through each getter
- `test_team_rank_gate_tristate` - team_rank_gate is tri-state: a profile 0 stores force-off, a negative value is skipped as unset, and setup_dasllama_jobque_ lands 1 or 0 on the live que while unset leaves the que alone
- `test_partial_and_missing_are_no_ops` - A partial runtime section applies only its present key, and a sidecar with no runtime section, a missing file, invalid JSON or a threads-only advisory leaves every knob at its default
- `test_jobque_pool_knobs_apply` - A runtime section jobque_pool and phase_decode_workers set the next job queue thread count and decode worker count to the written values
- `test_gemv_lane_cap_zero_refused_on_hybrid` - On a slow-tier hybrid box a sidecar gemv_lane_cap of 0 is refused and the seeded cap stands, while a nonzero cap in the same profile shape applies
- `test_slow_tier_kind_contract` - A box classified as compute slow tier reports a known nonzero perf-core count strictly below its total hardware core count
- `test_metal_prefill_knobs_apply` - The Metal, Vulkan and CUDA prefill knobs in a runtime section apply as written, a zero floor, panel or cvt row count is refused while a zero knee applies, and each setter refuses a negative knee
- `test_backend_pin_applies` - A runtime backend pin naming an unregistered backend keeps the active backend, and a pin to portable makes it the active kernel backend
- `test_stale_binary_sidecar_keeps_runtime` - A sidecar of this box back-dated under the binary reads stale_binary, and the checked apply still applies its runtime knobs and raises the applied flag
- `test_foreign_sidecar_applies_nothing` - A sidecar whose provenance names another box reads foreign_box, and the checked apply sets no runtime knob and records foreign_box as the decline
- `test_stale_foreign_sidecar_applies_nothing` - A back-dated sidecar of another box reads foreign_box rather than stale, and the checked apply sets no knob and declines naming the box, not the date
- `test_stale_unreadable_sidecar_applies_nothing` - A back-dated sidecar with no provenance reads unreadable rather than stale, and the checked apply sets no knob and declines as unreadable
- `test_metal_tensor_knob_leaves_the_crowns_unapplied` - In a child process DASLLAMA_METAL_TENSOR=0 leaves the profile Metal tensor crowns unapplied, while the same profile with the knob unset crowns mulmm_q8
- `test_kernels_only_sidecar_declines_as_no_runtime` - A sidecar of this box carrying only kernel winners and no runtime section makes the checked apply decline as no_runtime_section
- `test_apply_status_describes_the_last_checked_apply` - The applied flag and decline reason describe only the most recent checked apply: an own-box apply clears an earlier foreign decline, and a later foreign one lowers the flag again
- `test_mtp_depth_knobs_apply_per_round_kind` - The profile mtp_depth_nextn and mtp_depth_assistant knobs set the draft depth per round kind, an explicit set_mtp_depth wins over both, and clearing it hands the knobs back

### test_chat.das

- `test_chat_tinyllama_zephyr` - The chat engine first-turn prefill for TinyLlama equals the hand-built Zephyr token sequence (BOS, system, user, assistant headers with EOS separators) token for token
- `test_chat_gemma` - The Gemma-2 first-turn prefill folds the system text into the first user turn and equals the hand-built start-of-turn token sequence token for token
- `test_chat_phi` - The Phi-3.5 first-turn prefill equals the hand-built Phi-3 sequence of system, user, end and assistant special ids around the encoded text token for token
- `test_chat_qwen` - The Qwen2.5 prefill equals the hand-built ChatML sequence token for token, and the marked render reports the system turn as the first turn opening and none on a later turn
- `test_chat_llama3` - The Llama-3.2 prefill equals the hand-built header sequence with the knowledge-cutoff and pinned date lines, keeps those lines with no system message, and uses today when the date is unpinned
- `test_chat_end_to_end` - A greedy Gemma-2 respond streams a non-empty reply, records the user and assistant turns, and its session stats count exactly the streamed tokens and a nonzero prefill
- `test_chat_tools_hermes` - On Qwen2.5 the Hermes system tool block, the default-system assistant tool-call replay and the tool-results turn render token for token, the tool-call markers as single vocab ids
- `test_chat_think_suppress` - On Qwen3 set_thinking false appends the empty think block to the generation prompt, while on Qwen2.5 without think tokens it changes nothing and the reply think matcher stays unarmed
- `test_chat_preserve_thinking` - On Qwen3 a replayed assistant turn renders no think block with preserve_thinking off, the empty block with it on and no reasoning, and the reasoning between the markers when given
- `test_chat_xml_function` - A template with parameter blocks sniffs to the Qwen3.6 xml_function tool format, and on Qwen3.5 its first turn, call replay, results, thinking replay and back-to-back user turns render the template exact text
- `test_chat_gemma4_instruct_text_turn` - Gemma-4 E2B with thinking off answers 2+2 with 4, keeps every channel marker out of the content half, and ends the turn on a stop before the 64-token budget
- `test_gemma4_e_media_body` - On Gemma-4 E2B a fused media body whose text rows keep their token ids yields last-row logits within 0.25 of the peak of the text-rows-text split, while dropping the ids moves them past 1.0 of the peak
- `test_chat_gptoss_budget_marks` - On gpt-oss-20b the reasoning budget opens on the channel mark, analysis and message mark, leaves on the end mark, forces a close into the final channel, and ends the turn on a later channel mark
- `test_chat_gemma4_thinking` - Gemma-4 E2B defaults to thinking with channel-thought budget marks; instruct mode adds the channel stops and renders the bare model turn, thinking-on gates the system turn, and no late gate appears
- `test_chat_qwen35_tools` - The qwen35 registration declares the Hermes tool markers and prelude, and on Qwen3.5-0.8B the system tool block renders those markers as single vocab ids
- `test_chat_tool_modes` - Each family declares its ToolMode by registration or template detection, harmony reasoning level follows an explicit effort else the thinking flag, and a mode missing its control specials demotes to none
- `test_chat_gemma4_tool_wire` - On Gemma-4 E2B the tool declaration DSL turn, the open call replay, the in-turn result and thinking re-open render token for token, and displaced results and a leaked open turn heal on the next render
- `test_chat_template_detection` - Template fragments sniff to each family distinctive user-turn special regardless of arch, INST-family templates close the assistant turn with EOS, and a template-less GGUF falls back by arch and tokenizer
- `test_chat_strip_think` - strip_think removes a leading think block, whitespace before it included, empties an unclosed one, and passes through replies with no leading block or a mid-reply think tag
- `test_chat_pending_cleared_on_consume` - respond and add_assistant each clear the consumed pending user text, and add_assistant also clears queued image and audio rows and their buffers
- `test_chat_render_seam` - A renderer chat holds no KV and renders exactly the tokens add_assistant evals: the rendered stream prefilled on a fresh session leaves byte-equal key and value caches
- `test_chat_inline_span` - On voxtral an inline audio span renders as the splice head, the span position ids and the tail at any text offset, keeps its span in a replayed turn, and position ids differ by row and key
- `test_chat_span_refusals` - On a marker-less template add_user_span_ queues a bare audio span in text order, and panics on a span of no rows, an image or marked audio span, or one ahead of the span queued before it
- `test_gemma4_instruct_opener` - A gemma-4 template non-thinking opener follows the template: the 12B form closes an empty thought channel after the model turn, the E-series form opens bare, and both thinking openers are bare
- `test_llama_system_header` - The Llama-3 system header is read off the template (fixed date, clock or none), and on Llama-3.2 a tool turn adds the environment line before the cutoff while a pinned date overrides the template
- `test_chatml_default_system` - A ChatML template default system text is its literal system string, from template text or a string literal, and empty where the system span is only an expression or absent
- `test_chat_audio_markers` - render_prompt_audio ends the voxtral head on BEGIN_AUDIO with no closing marker and splices at the asked text offset, and brackets qwen2audio rows in audio_bos and audio_eos

### test_compares.das

The suites' shared compares (`_compares.das`) against hand-built rows: a NaN or a length difference is never inside a bar, each `check` bar kind passes its rows and reds one past it, and the poisoned-expectation control reds a bar too loose to see it. No skips.

- `test_maxdiff_sees_nan` - logits_maxdiff, maxdiff_at and logits_maxabs read a NaN on either side at any position, or a length difference, as an infinite difference, while finite rows read their true difference
- `test_mismatch_counts` - mismatch_exact counts each missing or extra element of a length difference as a mismatch, spans index correctly, and mismatch_rel counts a NaN as off at a relative or absolute bar
- `test_check_bars` - Every check bar kind (rel_of_larger, exact, rel_of_max, envelope, per_element) passes rows inside it and reds one element past it, and the poisoned-expectation control reds a bar too loose to see its poison
- `test_check_nan_and_length` - check reds a NaN on either side at any bar and a length difference, an empty compare reds its control, check_count counts without asserting, and check_exceeds passes only a finite miss
- `test_check_exact_typed` - check_exact on byte and word rows counts differences and length mismatches, reds an empty compare, and reds when the poisoned expectation rounds away as at 1e8 plus 1
- `test_compare_helpers` - The plane, poisoned-copy and span helpers build the exact rows asked, argmax_of picks the first largest within n, and opaque passes floats and words through unchanged
- `test_sweep_tally` - A length sweep tallies cases, elements, misses, the worst element, poisons inside the bar and inert elements, and report_sweep reds each defect and a sweep with no length or element

### test_cpu_prefill_tripwire.das

- `test_cpu_prefill_tripwire` - On a Metal-capable build an undeclared 40-row CPU prefill panics the tripwire for a non-causal span, a causal prefill, an mrope quantum and a deepstack quantum alike

### test_cuda_kernels.das

- `test_cud_q8_gemv` - The CUDA q8 GEMV class kernel stores every row and matches the CPU q8 oracle within 1e-3 of the larger magnitude on one, two and three interleaved regions with partial blocks, and the launch census counts it.
- `test_cud_q8_gemv_rate` - The q8 GEMV at the llama-1B 2048 x 2048 projection shape matches the CPU oracle on its warm-up launch, then logs a positive event-timed rate over 50 launches.
- `test_cud_worker_thread_binds` - A worker thread's context binds the CUDA device at every tier entry: with the thread's binding dropped, the ready device binds again and the free-memory query reads nonzero with the driver's error clear.
- `test_cud_q8_cm2s_split` - The q8 cm2 s tile split two and four ways along K (the last chunk short at K 1280) and reduced matches the whole-K f16-feed oracle at 31 rows, the tile footprint past the region left at the sentinel.
- `test_cud_cm2s_short_split_family` - Every per-format cm2 s column compiles and, split along K at 31 rows and reduced, matches its format's own CPU oracle at the f16 operand bar, the tile footprint past the region left at the sentinel.
- `test_cud_short_window_pick` - The CUDA cm2 pick under 32 rows keeps the s column whole with the split knee off and splits it by the shared rule on it (32x4x256, 32x2x768), while a full 32-row column takes the wave model's pick whatever the knee.
- `test_cud_q8_cm2l_split` - The q8 cm2 l tile split in two K chunks (576 as 512 + 64, and 2048) and reduced matches the whole-K f16-feed oracle at the tile bar over 300 rows, the tile footprint past the region left at the sentinel.
- `test_cud_q8_cm2l_batch` - The q8 cm2 l tile over two scheduled regions of 300 and 260 rows at K 576 stores every row and matches the f16-feed CPU oracle within 2e-3 of the plane's largest magnitude.
- `test_cud_q8_mmq` - The MMQ-shaped q8 int8 GEMM at K 768 over 256 weight rows and 256 tokens matches the block-scaled CPU reference (each block's exact int32 dot times its two scales) within 1e-3 of the larger magnitude.
- `test_cud_nv4_mmq` - The NVFP4 MMQ leaf on the FP4 tensor rung over the k4-tiled nv4 plane matches the e2m1 x UE4M3 CPU reference under each token's row scale and the site scale, within 1e-3 of the larger magnitude.
- `test_cud_k4_mmq` - The Q4_K MMQ leaf over four repacked superblocks matches the CPU per-block fold xs x (d sc dot - dmin mn qsum) at the f16 tiles' bar, its min terms f16-staged and folded in two groups of sixteen blocks.
- `test_cud_sb_mmq` - The min-term-free superblock MMQ leaves IQ4_XS, Q4_0 and IQ4_NL at K 1024 each match the block-scaled CPU reference (xs x scale x the block dot) within 1e-3 of the larger magnitude.
- `test_cud_b32_mmq` - The per-32 MMQ leaves Q5_1, Q4_0, Q5_0 and IQ4_NL match the engine's own per-32 dequant dotted with the activation quants, per element at 1e-3, Q5_1 at the f16 tiles' bar for its f16-staged m term.
- `test_cud_nv4_fp4_mmq_moe` - The nv4 FP4 expert leaf over the CPU schedule twin's s and m columns (buckets of 20, 150, 300 rows) matches the e2m1 x UE4M3 reference under each expert's site scale, the rows past the window kept at the sentinel.
- `test_cud_mx4_fp4_mmq_moe` - The mx4 FP4 expert leaf over the schedule's s and m columns at K 2880 (a k tail) matches the e2m1 x UE8M0 reference on every row of three packed buckets, the rows past the window kept at the sentinel.
- `test_cud_kq_cm2_family` - Every superblock format's kq cm2 tile on the l, m and s columns (mx4 on s and e alone) compiles and matches the Vulkan cells' per-format CPU oracle over two scheduled regions at the coopmat f16-operand bar.
- `test_cud_kq_gemv_family` - Every kq GEMV leaf (all 15 superblock formats) compiles and matches the Vulkan cell's CPU oracle at 256, 512 and 5120 wide under the subgroup, 16- and 8-lane row splits, within 2e-3 under a poison control.
- `test_cud_b32_gemv_family` - The per-32 GEMV leaves (Q5_1, IQ4_NL, Q4_0, Q5_0, and mx4 up to gpt-oss's 2880) match the engine's scalar row dot at two widths each over two regions of three rows, within 2e-3 under a poison control.
- `test_cud_emb_family` - The token-table gathers of all 15 superblock formats, 4 per-32 formats and the f32 table match their oracles on three ids past a one-row lead plus a host-staged row within 2e-3, the f32 grid's footprint kept at the sentinel.
- `test_cud_ple_finish` - ple_finish rewrites six 256-wide side slices in place to (side + pnorm x rms-normed proj) / sqrt 2 within 2e-3 of the CPU finish a slice at a time, one norm over every slice the control that misses.
- `test_cud_router_gemv_bf16` - The bf16 router GEMV stamps (pairs at dim 1536, halfword at odd dim 1537) match the CPU dot of 32 rows over three columns at a row base and an output base under yscale within 2e-3, the sentinel outside kept.
- `test_cud_f16_gemm` - The small f16 GEMM on the cm2 tile matches the f32 dot of the same f16 values within 2e-5 of the largest magnitude on five shapes up to an E2B projection window, the header and the tile footprint past the rows kept at the sentinel.
- `test_cud_ple_bf16_cvt` - ple_bf16_cvt stores 1030 bf16 values as f16 bit for bit the half of each widened value, saturating past the half range at 65504, and leaves the grid's footprint past the count untouched.
- `test_cud_act_biased` - The gpt-oss biased act twins (Q8_0 and Q8_K requant, and f16) under silu and the clamped swiglu match the CPU act over the host-biased rows (quants within one step, scales and halves at 2e-3), the unbiased act a control that misses.
- `test_cud_fp4_feeds` - The FP4 feed kernels match the CPU feed: fp4_rows bit for bit, the silu gate/up feed and the fused residual + rmsnorm feed within one nibble or code word in 800, row scales at 2e-3, under a flipped-word count control.
- `test_cud_moe_mmq_fits` - crd_moe_mmq_fits admits mx4 on the 64 lattice and unbiased nv4 on the 256 lattice (gpt-oss 2880 x 2880, the 35B-A3B 2048 x 768) and refuses an off-lattice width, a biased nv4 stack and a q40 stack.
- `test_cud_mx4_feeds` - The MXFP4 feed kernels at gpt-oss's 2880 match the CPU feed: mx4_rows bit for bit, mx4_actrows and its biased twin within one word in 800, the biased output landing past that allowance off the unbiased feed as the control.
- `test_cud_q8k_feeds` - The Q8_K and Q8_0 feed kernels match the Vulkan cells' CPU oracles: the plain Q8_K requant bit for bit, the silu act + requant and the fused residual + rmsnorm + requant within one quant step, scales at 2e-3.
- `test_cud_words_copy` - The words copy kernel carries 1000 and 1003 words (a quad-lane run and a three-word tail) from a mapped host block through the device to another mapped block bit for bit, the four words past n keeping their poison.
- `test_cud_fa_h64` - The cm2 flash tile at head 64, f32 and f16 out, matches fa_oracle within 2e-3 of the plane's largest magnitude whole and under a 40-key window, and the gpt-oss sink stamps match it under a per-head sink logit, off the sink-free control.
- `test_cud_q8_kv_store` - The q8_0 K/V store at token rows and at window rows writes the CPU cache codec's mirror bytes bit for bit, a block scale past the half range clamped and every byte outside the stored rows left at its fill.
- `test_cud_kv_shadow` - The q8_0 and tq4 mirrors' f16 shadow pass writes the CPU dequant rounded to half and clamped at 65504 bit for bit over its rows, the rows outside the pass left at their NaN fill.
- `test_cud_q8_da_attn` - The q8_0 decode attention stamps (four- and two-head slabs, the eight-piece split form, the gpt-oss sink stamp) match the CPU attention over the dequantized mirror rows at 300 keys within 1e-4, off the unquantized or sink-free control.
- `test_cud_tq4_kv_store` - The tq4 K/V store at token and window rows writes the CPU rotation's cache bytes bit for bit and rotates the q rows in place exactly, heads 32 to 512, a scale past the half range clamped, shared-KV and no-q layers included.
- `test_cud_tq4_unrot` - The tq4 un-rotation matches the CPU un-rotation bit for bit at heads 32, 64 and 512 and within 2e-3 under the sigmoid of the q panel's gate half at head 128, the rows moved off their input and off the ungated form.
- `test_cud_tq4_da_attn` - The tq4 decode attention stamps (four- and two-head slabs) match the CPU attention over the dequantized rotated mirror rows at 300 keys within 1e-4, the attention under the unrotated query the control that misses.
- `test_cud_fa_h96` - The cm2 flash tile at head 96, f32 and f16 out, matches fa_oracle within 2e-3 of the plane's largest magnitude on 77 rows past a 64-key base, whole and under a 40-key window, the f16 slack rows poisoned.
- `test_cud_fa_h128` - The cm2 flash tile at head 128 (the 3B class's attention), f32 and f16 out, matches fa_oracle within 2e-3 of the plane's largest magnitude, whole and under a 40-key window, the f16 slack rows poisoned.
- `test_cud_fa_h256` - The cm2 flash tile at head 256, f32 and f16 out, matches fa_oracle within 2e-3 whole and under a 40-key window, plain and gated, the gated rows under the q panel's gate sigmoid and off the ungated oracle.
- `test_cud_fa_h256_softcap` - The head-256 softcap stamps, f32 and f16 out, match the CPU attention oracle capped at 50 within 2e-3, whole and under a 40-key window, the scores running past the cap and the uncapped oracle the control.
- `test_cud_fa_h512` - The flash tile at head 512 on the KHR arm (gemma-4's global layers), f32 and f16 out, matches fa_oracle within 2e-3 of the plane's largest magnitude, whole and under a 40-key window.
- `test_cud_qkn_rope` - The fused q/k norm + rope + K/V store, f32 and f16 mirror stamps, matches qkn_rope_rows within 2e-3 on the q heads in place and the K and V mirror rows, the mirror rows ahead of the layer's kept at their fill.
- `test_cud_q8_cm2l_rate` - The q8 cm2 l tile at three 1B pp512 shapes holds its warm-up bit for bit to the f16-feed oracle on activation rows 0, 255, 256 and 511 over a fixture its f16 accumulator sums exactly, then logs a rate.
- `test_cud_dn_family` - The deltanet kernels at heads 32, 64 and 128 match their CPU oracles: conv and fused step (Q8_0, f32, sigmoid o rows) at 2e-3, the per-token and chunked scans under the silu and sigmoid out-norm at 1e-2, the ring tail bit for bit.
- `test_cud_moe_routing` - Every routed-block routing kernel - router GEMM, top-k up to 512 experts, the bucket schedule word for word, the gathers and combines over a slot window, the combine-folded residual step - matches the shared CPU oracle.
- `test_cud_compile_gate` - Every cuda_dispatch kernel of the CUDA home, at least 52 seeded, compiles through NVRTC and loads, with no kernel refused.
- `test_cud_shutdown_leaks` - The CUDA tier's shutdown runs a registered hook exactly once when the device came up (never without one) and leaves no CUDA object or allocation live; this gate never skips.

### test_cuda_mint.das

the lane the home mints is its own, by the engine's names: the tag's lane name and the file's lane segment both read the armed backend's name (`moe_gpu_backend_name`, `cuda` under the CUDA ask)

- `test_cuda_mint_lanes` - A cold CUDA-armed load of Qwen3.5-0.8B-MTP mints the cuda lane alone, and the trimmed lane serves the device twin greedy tokens and CPU embed rows cold and maps back warm to the same tokens
- `test_cuda_mint_kquant` - The Qwen3.5-0.8B Q4_K_M twin mints its cuda lane off its native K-quant planes, named for the armed backend, and maps back warm to the same greedy tokens
- `test_cuda_mint_kv_codecs` - A trimmed cuda lane minted under a q8_0 K/V mirror maps under tq4 and f16 with no re-mint and serves at each codec the tokens the staged load serves there
- `test_cuda_mint_identity_cap` - The cuda bake tag budget word reads the card total memory less at most 1 GB of headroom unpinned, and exactly the pinned figure under a 4096 MB VRAM pin

### test_cuda_tower_asr.das

- `test_cud_wdec_classes` - The whisper decoder K/V store in its three layouts and the chunked causal and cross attention pair on the CUDA home match the CPU decoder forms, with causal-versus-cross and scaled-keys controls
- `test_cud_wdec_fused_rq` - The layernorm, post-add, bias-activation and attention combine fused with the Q8_0 requant on the CUDA home match the separate pass then requant and the CPU forms at three widths incl. whisper tiny and turbo
- `test_cud_tower_clamp_rq` - tower_clamp_rq on the CUDA home reproduces the CPU clamp then Q8_0 requant of the rows, a poisoned scale reds it, and the unclamped requant misses as the control
- `test_cud_tower_vad` - The silero VAD encoder over three chunks and its recurrence at one and five chunks from a nonzero state on the CUDA home match the CPU VAD oracle at the approx bar
- `test_cud_rnnt` - The transducer decode gates, projection, joint and pick stamps on the CUDA home match the CPU RNNT oracle at both rc_shapes
- `test_cud_ctc_pick` - The CTC pick on the CUDA home writes every record with the CPU class exactly and plogs within 1e-5 relative over three widths, a tie taking the lower class and an all-NaN row class 0, a poisoned bias the control
- `test_cud_asr_shutdown_leaks` - After the ASR stamp cells, the CUDA tier shutdown leaves no CUDA object or device allocation live, as counted by the leak log

- `test_cud_tower_ga_dwh` - The CUDA gigaam f16-tap depthwise conv matches the CPU loop over the same halfwords, itself bit-exact to the f32 loop, and a poisoned tap reds it

- `test_cud_tower_post_add_plain` - The CUDA plain residual seam with its next rms, at ascale 0.5 and with ln_on 0, matches the CPU form, and the post-norm seam CPU form is the control
- `test_cud_tower_post_add_ln_nb` - The CUDA bias-less residual seam with its next layernorm, and alone at ln_on 0, matches the CPU form, with the biased seam form as the control

- `test_cud_tower_post_add` - The CUDA gemma4v post-normed residual seam and its next rms match the CPU form at ascale 1, at ln_on 0 and at ascale 0.5, with the add minus post-norm as the control
- `test_cud_tower_post_add_rms` - The CUDA qwen25v biased residual seam and its next rms, and the seam alone at ln_on 0, match the CPU form, with the add minus the bias row as the control

- `test_cud_tower_post_add_ln16` - The CUDA biased residual seam with its next layernorm into halves equals its f32 twin rounded bit for bit, also at ln_on 0, and matches the CPU form
- `test_cud_tower_cn_attn_rel_plane` - The CUDA canary rel-plane attention at both head widths matches the CPU rel-pos loop with u and v biases, idle lanes writing nothing, with scaled keys and rel planes as controls
- `test_cud_f16_gemm_s` - The CUDA f16 GEMM s-column stamp matches the f32 dot of the same halves and equals its m-column twin bit for bit
- `test_cud_f16_cm2_col` - f16_cm2_col picks the 32-wide s column up to 64 rows, the 128-wide m column when the SM count is unknown, and the cheaper wave past that, pinned at literal shapes and SM counts
- `test_cud_tower_cm2_pick` - On a 35 to 48 SM card the CUDA tower Q8_0 cm2 pick reads the pinned column, split and tile counts at the fc2 race shapes, each seam answers the value it replaced, and the seams are put back
- `test_cud_tower_flavor_refusals` - qwen3a takes no CUDA flavor with the tower knob off or with no home armed, and a child load logs the exact line naming each condition

- `test_cud_tts_im2col16` - The CUDA stamp of `tts_im2col16` matches the CPU 1-D im2col as halves on channel- and row-major sources, strides 1 and 2, off and on the four-channel lattice, keeping the halves before and past the panel

- `test_cud_tower_ln_relu` - The CUDA stamp of `tower_ln_relu` applies channel LayerNorm then ReLU in place within the approximate bar of the CPU loop, actually moves live elements, and keeps the rows past the live ones

- `test_cud_tower_mel_norm` - The CUDA stamp of `tower_mel_norm` applies canary per-feature normalization over the valid frames like the CPU loop, zeroes the tail exactly, and writes nothing past the plane an idle column lane reaches
- `test_cud_tower_ga_frames` - The CUDA stamp of `tower_ga_frames` writes gigaam windowed frames bit for bit against the CPU frame loop, zero pad rows and a window read at an element base included
- `test_cud_tower_dw_conv` - The CUDA stamp of `tower_dw_conv` matches the CPU k3 s2 p1 depthwise conv with bias over channel-major taps on the 7 x 5 image behind a poison row and on the 11 x 10 image
- `test_cud_tower_pk_dw2d` - The CUDA stamp of `tower_pk_dw2d` matches the CPU parakeet depthwise conv over tap-major taps, both unmasked and with the rows past a shorter valid length masked
- `test_cud_front_shutdown_leaks` - After the front cells, shutting the CUDA tier down leaves zero live CUDA objects or allocations; this leak gate never skips

### test_cuda_tower_whisper_chain.das

- `test_cud_rail_gemv_q8` - CUDA `rail_gemv_q8` viewed onto one record's region pairs inside a larger schedule plane matches the CPU q8 oracle within 1e-3, restores the schedule seat whole, and a view at record 0 reads zero words instead (control)

### test_dasllama_lint_contracts.das

- `test_boot_restore_order_gate` - A spawned compile proves `[boot_restore]` refuses a module with a function-pointer global declared below the restore function, naming the order, and compiles the same module with every global above
- `test_lint_escape` - With `options _dasllama_internal` set, a file requiring the engine module `dasllama_version` directly compiles and reads `DASLLAMA_RELEASE`
- `test_allowed_set_admits_the_entry_modules` - Spawned compiles prove the DASLLAMA001 allowed set: a program requiring the facade, scheduler, exchange schema and bench entries compiles clean, while a direct engine-internal require is refused with DASLLAMA001
- `test_load_audio_16k_mono_contract` - `load_audio_16k_mono` on a missing file returns an empty array rather than panicking
- `test_decode_audio_frame_cap` - `decode_audio_16k_mono` decodes a short 8 kHz WAV within the frame cap, refuses a 1 Hz decompression-bomb WAV to empty before decoding, and treats cap 0 as unbounded
- `test_gemma4a_probe_rejects_non_gguf` - `gemma4a_probe_proj_dim` returns 0 without panicking on a .dlim path, a missing file, and a file of non-GGUF bytes

### test_deltanet.das

- `test_deltanet_chunked_prefill` - On Qwen3.5-0.8B with GPU routes and vector activations pinned off, a 150-token chunked deltanet prefill lands within 4 percent of max logit of the recurrent one, and stays there over 8 forced-feed decode steps, while a one-step-off compare reds the bar
- `test_deltanet_yarn_override` - On Qwen3.5-0.8B the rope-scaling override refuses unknown kinds and factor-less yarn, folds linear and none exactly, and YaRN x4 lands the divisors and mscale in the decode rope row against an fp64 fold, with table and direct paths agreeing and the fold moving the logits
- `test_deltanet_owner_release` - A session's deltanet owner token spans exactly the host dn_state range, and a counting release hook sees one release carrying that range on position-zero reset, on speculative rollback, and on delete
- `test_deltanet_state_sizing` - A model-free run state at 27B deltanet geometry allocates the 144 MB S state, and a d_conv 64 twin the conv history, each in one grow past the max_unreserved_size guard with the exact element counts

### test_dflash_drafter.das

- `test_dflash_refusals` - `load_dflash_drafter` refuses a missing path, a non-GGUF file, and a synthesized drafter with an IQ4_XS fc.weight (naming tensor, disk type and member) with a reason and no weights, while a Q4_K fc.weight passes tagged k4 (control)
- `test_dflash_27b_sampled_cpu` - On the 27B trunk with the Q8_0 DFlash2 drafter on the CPU arm, the exact-accept sampled speculative walk equals the plain seeded sampled walk with drafts accepted, honors a stop id, and both rejection walks accept some drafts and reject some
- `test_dflash_27b_sampled_metal` - On the Metal device arm over the 27B GGUF trunk, the sampled DFlash walks hold the CPU arm's exact and rejection contracts, drawn drafts end on the device selector, and verify-ahead off or the soft pick off reproduce the same stream
- `test_dflash_27b_mlx_sampled` - The sampled DFlash walks on the Metal device arm hold over the 27B affine mlx 4-bit snapshot trunk: exact equals the plain sampled walk, rejection walks accept and reject, and device and host draws give the same stream
- `test_dflash_27b_cpu` - On the planar 27B Q4_K_M trunk with the Q8_0 DFlash2 drafter on the CPU arm, the greedy speculative walk emits the plain greedy walk's ids token for token with drafts accepted
- `test_dflash_27b_k4_cpu` - The Q4_K_M DFlash2 drafter tags every plane with its disk type's format, and on the CPU arm its greedy speculative walk emits the plain greedy walk's ids token for token with drafts accepted
- `test_dflash_27b_metal` - On the Metal device arm over the 27B GGUF trunk the greedy DFlash walk is lossless; device accept and selector match the host's drafts and accept count, replays commit unwaited on the tape, the CPU arm accepts the same count, and depth pins hold
- `test_dflash_27b_mlx_metal` - The lossless greedy DFlash gate on the Metal device arm holds over the 27B mlx 4-bit snapshot trunk, with device and host accept and selector agreeing and mlx4b planes among the trunk's rows8 verify sites where rows8 runs
- `test_dflash_27b_k4_metal` - The Q4_K_M DFlash2 drafter tags planes by disk type and its greedy walk on the Metal device arm is lossless, with k4 and k6 sites encoded by the pass and device and host accept and selector agreeing

### test_dispatch_shaping.das

- `test_gpu_served_spin_window` - Arming the GPU-served dispatch flag switches the job queue's spin window in force from the CPU window to the GPU window, and dropping it switches back
- `test_gemv_chunks_default` - A tripwire pinning the shipped `gemv_chunks_per_lane` default at 8, so a move forces a retune of the ladder tables
- `test_lanes_for_work` - `lanes_for_work` stays inline below twice the target chunk work, grows work over target lanes in the mid band, saturates to the live pool, honors caps and the worker limit, and moves with the target knob
- `test_matmul_chunks_batch` - Batch `matmul_chunks` returns the inline signal under twice the target, whole lane-waves capped by the row grain on huge work, never fewer than the admitted lanes, the raw oversplit with grain off, and a wave width bounded by the batch cap
- `test_matmul_grid` - `matmul_grid` stays 1-D with the knob off, goes 2-D at 16-token cells on grain-starved shapes under knob 1, makes whole lane-waves or falls back 1-D under knob 2, never exceeds the unit count, and clamps the knob to 0..2
- `test_matmul_chunks_gemv` - `matmul_chunks_gemv` returns the inline signal under twice the target, one chunk a lane past the GEMV grain, wave-fills grain-capped counts unless wave fill is off, honors the gemv cap, and in fine-grain mode makes whole 64-row waves capped at the per-lane count

### test_driver_knob_getters.das

- `test_mtp_depth_pin` - `mtp_depth_pin` reads back whether and at what depth `set_mtp_depth` pinned, and `restore_mtp_depth` puts back both a cleared and a pinned state exactly as found
- `test_unregister_decode_override` - `unregister_decode_override` removes a probe override and its batched step, deselects it only when active, and a re-registered single-stream name arms no batch twin while a re-registered batch step does
- `test_metal_knob_getters` - Each Metal driver knob getter (decode fuse, prefill last row, gemma trace, gemma carry pre-norm) reads back what its setter set and the value found restores, and the carry choice leaves the decode carry alone with no drafter attached

### test_embeddings.das

Qwen3-Embedding's model-card example: the instruction-prefixed queries, the two passages, and the published cosine matrix for the 0.6B model (rows = queries, columns = passages)

- `test_embeddings_hidden_only_window` - On Metal, Qwen3-Embedding 0.6B's embed rides one prefill window with no classifier and no decode mirror (a chat forward does both), takes split-K on q8 sites, matches the card matrix within 0.02, and its one-row vector is the CPU f32 model's
- `test_embeddings_qwen3_embedding` - Qwen3-Embedding 0.6B Q8_0 reads last-token pooling and an appended EOS off the file, and its last-token read lands the model card's 2 x 2 cosine matrix within 0.02 while the mean read cannot separate the passages (control)
- `test_embeddings_past_the_context` - On tinyllama, a text running past the context embeds to a finite unit vector at cosine above 0.9999 to its leading seq_len tokens alone, while the overflow text by itself embeds elsewhere
- `test_embeddings_chat_model_default_mean` - A chat model file naming no pooling (tinyllama) defaults to mean pooling float for float, appends no EOS, and differs from both the last-token and the first-row reads
- `test_embeddings_batch_matches_single` - `embed_batch` on Qwen3-Embedding 0.6B gives each text its single `embed` vector at cosine above 0.9999 in one window, in 40-row split windows and under the 256-dim Matryoshka cut, returned in input order
- `test_embeddings_lone_forwards` - In a host batch, exactly the one-row text runs `embed_forward` alone while multi-row texts share the window, and every text of a q4_0 load runs alone, each landing its single vector at cosine above 0.9999 with a shifted-text control missing
- `test_embeddings_on_the_resident_driver` - The whole-model Vulkan driver serves Qwen3-Embedding 0.6B on the device with no CPU-rail pass: the card matrix within 0.02, a batch packed in one scratch window matching its singles, and a long mean read equal to the CPU's
- `test_embeddings_ring_layers_take_a_window_each` - On gemma-3-1b with sliding layers the whole-model driver's packed seat declines on either discrete home, so a batch takes no packed window, prefills every text on the device, and still matches its singles at cosine above 0.9999
- `test_embeddings_window_rows_follow_the_region` - `embed_window_rows` is the armed driver's capped region context for a served model, so a batch past 256 rows takes the predicted count of scratch windows and matches its singles, and is EMBED_WINDOW_ROWS for an unserved model
- `test_embeddings_every_region_held` - With every device region held by a live session, `embed_batch` takes host-cached sessions and no scratch window yet reads the same vectors as with a region free, and parking the streams frees every region
- `test_embeddings_ple_model_takes_no_scratch` - On the armed driver, gemma-4 E2B with per-layer embeddings and sliding layers is promised no scratch window, runs none, and its mean-pooled batch still matches its singles at cosine above 0.9999
- `test_embeddings_session_rules` - `session_keeps_rows_only` is false exactly for recurrent state, a NextN head and the per-layer n-gram ring, and `embed_pool_key` tells two same-geometry models with empty fblobs apart while one model reads one key
- `test_embeddings_batch_fresh_sessions` - A Qwen3.5 deltanet batch takes fresh sessions without rebuilding the embed pool and matches its singles, and a pooled model of another geometry rebuilds the pool once while the embedding model's next read returns its earlier vector

- `test_no_env_reads_outside_the_declarations` - A source scan finds no raw environment read in modules/dasLLAMA or the dasllama server and convert tools outside `dasllama_env.das`
- `test_every_env_read_is_declared` - Every environment variable name read in the engine, tools, examples and tutorials has an EnvConfig declaration, with a walk-size guard of over 100 files so the scan cannot pass vacuously
- `test_no_ad_hoc_env_helpers` - A source scan finds no re-declared private environment-reader helper anywhere in the engine or the dasllama tools
- `test_environment_md_is_current` - The checked-in ENVIRONMENT.md equals what `env_markdown` renders from the declarations, line endings normalized
- `test_registry_has_no_duplicates` - The registered environment names number over 140 and contain no knob declared twice across the area structs
- `test_every_knob_is_documented` - Every row of the rendered environment doc carries a non-empty Effect column
- `test_registry_covers_every_documented_knob` - Every DASLLAMA-prefixed knob row `env_markdown` renders is present in `registered_env_names`, catching a struct wired into the doc renderer but not the registry

### test_exchange_schema.das

- `test_corpus_records` - Every in-tree bench record store under performance/records, at least five of them, passes the exchange validator's shape-level validation
- `test_corpus_sidecars` - Every current-format tune sidecar in records parses with kernels and a box identity and is named by the sha12 of its own bytes, with at least four current sidecars outnumbering the legacy ones
- `test_writer_round_trip` - The real bench record writer's stamped output passes shape and submission validation, while a store claiming official, an unstamped das run, or reference runs only is refused at submission grade
- `test_hostile_records` - The record validator refuses garbage, wrong-shape roots and non-object models, and through the real writer refuses zero threads, a malformed date, a rateless or negative test row, and over-long parity or noise stamps
- `test_held_bound` - The record validator accepts a ledger-row held string and rejects a numeric held and one past 1024 characters, naming the .held path in both errors
- `test_tune_stamp_bound` - The record validator accepts a seventeen-family amx tune stamp and rejects a tune stamp past its own 8192-character bound
- `test_hostile_sidecars` - A minimal versioned sidecar passes both grades and parses its info, while injection-shaped names, non-string winners, nested knobs, bad boxes, unknown sections, markup, and bad race demotion fields are rejected
- `test_record_redaction` - `redact_record_paths` strips usernames and leading directories from cmd, env and file paths while keeping flags, env keys and basenames, is idempotent, and returns empty on unparseable input
- `test_box_parse` - `parse_box_string` reads platform, model id and cpu from a five-field box, allows blank model id and os build, and refuses four fields, an empty cpu and an empty string
- `test_writer_phrases` - The tuner's `settle_note` provenance phrase passes sidecar submission validation, while the pre-fix arrow-and-percent spelling is refused with an error naming noise_probes
- `test_tune_scope_wire_key` - A textual pin: `dasllama_tune_scope.das` versions the tune scope off DASLLAMA_RELEASE under the wire key dasllama_version, so archived sidecars do not all read version-stale

### test_f32_batch_tile_perms.das

- `test_f32_batch_tile_perms` - Every permutation of `f32_batch_tile` stays within its own summation order's random-walk error bound of a double oracle at the iSTFT GEMM shape and at a wide dot entering every vector body, with a poisoned-weight control red for each
- `test_f32_tile_pin_seat` - The reference fp32 tile pin serves both `matmul_batch` forms bit-exact to the reference lattice ahead of an armed float-batch override, which sees no call while pinned, and the pin is put back after the block and after a re-raised panic
- `test_tuned_fallbacks_over_module_cache` - `dasllama_tuned_fallbacks` in a child names the same `f32_batch_tile` fallback and the same kernel count on a warm compile whose modules the module cache served as on the cold compile

### test_facade.das

- `test_spm_encode_respects_model_bos_eos` - SPM encode of empty text frames it with the tokenizer's own bos_id and eos_id (Gemma's 2 and 1), while a default SpmTokenizer keeps the Llama-2 ids 1 and 2
- `test_facade_jobque_spin_knob` - The facade's jobque spin knobs default to 30 ms and 500 us and their setters reach the engine, while with no driver armed the CPU window stays in force whatever the GPU knob reads
- `test_facade_spm` - `load_tokenizer_auto` on tinyllama selects SPM and encodes ids equal to the raw SentencePiece tokenizer's, with and without BOS
- `test_facade_bpe` - `load_tokenizer_auto` on Qwen2.5 selects BPE, encodes ids equal to raw `bpe_encode` with BOS only where the model asks, and decodes ASCII back exactly
- `test_facade_model` - `load_model_` populates the model's BPE tokenizer, and the model-level encode and piece return exactly what the tokenizer's own calls return
- `test_facade_eval_segments_empty` - `eval_segments` on a bare model returns without panicking for no segments, and refuses by name a chunk with no session and a null session before any read
- `test_facade_device_kv_rows` - `device_kv_max_rows` divides the installed room seam by K/V bytes a row over the layers owning rows (488 f16, 244 f32 in a megabyte), caps at the model context, and on Metal ignores the idle mirror cap
- `test_pp_rows_capacity` - On stories15M the pp bench warmup and a timed pp rep panic on a session whose seq_len is under the prompt length before writing, and the warmup runs on a session that fits
- `test_exe_smoke` - A standalone `-jit -exe` build of the facade root, as one unit and split with LTO, announces its build form and the artifact completes a 4-token SmolLM2 generate on the serialized-globals rail, so every function-typed global is boot-restored

### test_facade_docs.das

- `test_facade_docstrings_inside_body` - Every public def in the facade `dasllama_core.das` opens its body with a //! docstring, and no //! line sits directly above a def where the doc extractor cannot see it
- `test_facade_engine_names_one_to_one` - The facade's public defs and the listed engine files' trailing-underscore defs map one to one: each facade name wraps an engine name_ and each engine name_ has a facade stub
- `test_examples_are_facade_only` - The run.das and chat.das examples each carry exactly one dasllama require, and it is the facade `dasllama/dasllama_core`
- `test_dasllama_core_requires_no_decoder` - The transitive module dependencies of `dasllama_core` reach the engine but include neither `audio` nor `stbimage`, while the `dasllama` facade's include both decoders
- `test_stream_calls_refuse_without_a_model` - With no model open, the library example's `asr_feed`, `asr_listen` and `tts_speak` refuse with empty or zero results and a reason naming `asr_listen`, synthesizing nothing and never panicking
- `test_program_roots` - Every dasLLAMA program root under tutorials, examples and the server declares `options stack = 524288`, every model-loading root declares prefill intent in code, and more than ten roots are scanned so the census is not vacuous
- `test_howto_gate` - The REVIEW.das HOW_TO gate passes a clean fixture and fails, with exactly one named finding each, a past-tense marker, a 20YY-MM date, a #NNN number, and a numbered step citing no architecture anchor
- `test_locked_queue_gate` - The REVIEW.das queue-call gate passes a source using the locked one-shot (a commented call ignored) and fails with one finding each on run_cmd_sync, vkQueueSubmit, vkQueueWaitIdle and vkDeviceWaitIdle

### test_fat_hook_umbrella.das

- `test_the_umbrella_registers_the_first_start_hook` - A program requiring only the engine umbrella `dasllama_transformer`, not the facade, already has a first-start race hook installed by the umbrella's init set

### test_fat_start.das

- `test_runtime_snapshot_carries_the_crowns_and_knobs` - `dasllama_runtime_snapshot` carries the crown list as metal_tensor, the current (not default) q8_token_block value, the lane count as threads, and the Metal prefill constants
- `test_the_snapshot_needs_no_job_queue` - The runtime snapshot builds with no job queue open, recording threads as 0 instead of throwing and still carrying the knob values
- `test_first_start_race_writes_the_section_the_apply_reads` - The first-start race writes a redirected sidecar whose runtime section names the crown list and the split-K knees with an empty kernels section, and the checked box-profile apply then reads it back
- `test_the_knee_race_sets_the_split_knees` - On a Metal box the split-K knee race lands every knee, the n32 rows and the dev-W grid floor on a rung of its own race or off, and the snapshot records the raced K-quant knees; with no device every knee stands
- `test_the_vulkan_knee_race_sets_the_knee` - On a Vulkan device with the cm2 s column the short-window knee race overwrites a marker knob with a rung of its race or 0, recorded in the snapshot; on any other device the marker stands
- `test_the_cuda_knee_race_sets_the_knee` - Under the CUDA home the knee race lands the knob on a rung of its race or 0, recorded in the snapshot, and a second race leaves device bytes allocated unchanged; with no CUDA device a marker knob stands
- `test_the_apply_fires_the_race_hook_only_for_a_missing_section` - The box-profile apply fires an installed race hook exactly once for an absent sidecar, reads the knob the race minted, and never re-races once the box's own section exists
- `test_restoring_a_null_hook_disarms_the_race` - Restoring a null race hook after a fake one disarms the race: the apply on an absent section declines with absent instead of invoking a null function
- `test_the_fat_hook_is_inert_outside_a_fat_exe` - Outside a fat exe `dasllama_fat_first_start` declines and writes no sidecar
- `test_box_runtime_file` - The per-box runtime file sits at a stable box-keyed path under tune, is valid only for this box, these kernels and a runtime section, is raced and applied when no manifest is set, and stands down under a manifest or the reference policy
- `test_fat_sidecar_lives_per_user` - The fat sidecar lives under the per-user tune directory, is adopted from beside the exe once and never overwritten, its placement hook runs before the default apply reads the path, and only a chosen manifest counts as explicit
- `test_the_shared_knee_rule_and_pricing` - The shared GPU split-K rule engages at half the knee, doubles ways to eight while the grid fits, keeps shares in whole chunks, and the knee and cutoff pickers crown the cheapest priced rung, standing down under a 1 percent gain

### test_forward.das

- `test_forward_end_to_end` - On fp32 stories15M the tokenizer encodes the prompt to llama2.c's ids and empty-prompt greedy decode with scalar activations reproduces llama2.c's 12 token ids token for token
- `test_forward_q8` - With every 2-D weight of stories15M quantized to Q8_0, empty-prompt greedy decode still reproduces the llama2.c fp32 oracle's 12 token ids token for token
- `test_forward_q4` - With every 2-D weight of stories15M quantized to Q4_0, empty-prompt greedy decode still matches the llama2.c fp32 oracle over its 12-token prefix
- `test_forward_threaded_decode_attention` - Decode attention forced fully threaded and forced inline leaves bit-identical logits after five stories15M positions, so any difference is a race in the head loop

### test_fused_decode.das

- `test_fused_decode_bit_exact` - On Q8 stories15M with dispatch forced threaded, fused decode stage chains produce the per-op dispatch path's greedy ids and final logits bit for bit
- `test_fused_flash_deep_ctx` - Past 256 positions on SmolLM2-135M the fused flash-sliced attention passes an in-chain witness recomputing exact single-pass attention within 1e-4 at every sliced layer, and teacher-forced logits stay within a structural bound of 4 of the per-op path
- `test_fused_flash_deep_ctx_q8` - Under a q8_0 K/V cache past 256 positions on SmolLM2-135M, the fused flash-sliced attention passes the in-chain 1e-4 witness through the same quantized dot, and teacher-forced logits stay within a structural bound of 4 of the per-op path
- `test_fused_decode_pre_post_norm` - On the pre/post-norm arches gemma-3-1b, gemma-2-2b and gemma-4 E2B under the portable backend, fused decode chains match the per-op path's greedy ids and final logits bit for bit
- `test_fused_decode_kquant` - On Qwen3-4B Q5_K_M and Q4_K_M repacked for the native K-quant rows cores, fused decode chains with Q8_K activations match the per-op kq path's greedy ids and final logits bit for bit
- `test_fused_decode_moe_chain` - On gpt-oss-20b mxfp4 with an mx4 rows core, the fused MoE expert chain matches the three-dispatch groupn path's greedy ids and final logits bit for bit
- `test_fused_decode_attn_chain` - On SmolLM2-135M (head size 64, so the attention chain fuses too) fused decode matches the per-op path's greedy ids and final logits bit for bit on the auto backend's rows core and on the portable pin

- `test_gemma3v_tier1_gpu` - On the Metal tower gemma3v matches the mtmd encode dumps within 4e-2 of token rms with flash attention on and off, the knob-off leg runs the CPU chain with one decline, the q8 lane serves with a red poison control, and the f16 twin route serves

- `test_gemma3v_tier1_q8` - The gemma3v q8 block-GEMM serving lane matches the mtmd encode dumps within 0.32 of token rms on the CPU and on the serving discrete home's device rung, with a mid-stack zeroed-block poison red, and the vision carrier stamps q8 or f32 by lane
- `test_gemma3v_discrete_twin` - The serving discrete home's gemma3v chain matches the CPU q8 chain on one- and two-block towers and the full tower, a zeroed-block poison reds the one-block bar, and the exact f32 lane is served on the device

- `test_gemma4uv_tier1_gpu` - On the Metal tower with the SIMDGROUP kernel set pinned, the gemma4uv embedder matches the mtmd encode dumps within 2e-4 plus 4e-3 of token rms on four fixtures, each GPU-served by one encode

- `test_gemma4uv_tier1_vulkan` - The gemma4uv embedder whole on the serving discrete home's device holds the CPU 2e-4 bar on the mtmd encode dumps with the stem on device, a patch-zeroed control reds, and it serves again after a model-state drop

### test_gemma4v.das

- `test_gemma4v_tier1_gpu` - The gemma4v lane policy is q8 with the Metal tower off and exact with it armed, and the Metal tower matches the E2B mtmd dumps within 8e-3 of token rms on five canvases, with a knob-off decline leg and the q8 lane served with a red poison control

- `test_pybench_args` - `asr_pybench_args` builds each reference arm's argv: onnx with the recovery --out and never a device, nemo forwarding the device only when asked, mlx on the MLX venv with the variant and neither

- `test_cmake_built_bin_layouts` - `cmake_built_bin` prefers MSVC Release x.exe over x.exe over the bare name as each is planted, and returns the bare path when nothing is built

- `test_zero_cells_refusal` - `records_run_verdict` reds a run with zero cells measured (naming the guard) and any run with failed cells, and is green for one measured cell with no failures

- `test_catalog_scope` - --catalog admits only the case-sensitive official and all, the CPU legs' batched shape needs both axes at 1 or more or none at all, and the batched row's shape follows the CPU leg's own knobs or the Metal leg's flat rows
- `test_board_store_guard` - `board_store_refusal` refuses a --jit run, a --catalog all sweep and an mlx-lm store aimed at the public board store, by relative or absolute path, naming the flag and the fix, while the official board mint passes

- `test_cell_rates_split_the_axes` - `cell_rates` folds a das cell's pp and tg rows onto separate axes with the widest row's cv as worst, and a reference engine's rows reach neither axis nor the cv
- `test_heat_keeper` - `keep_cold` keeps the cold cell when a warm re-run is slower on either axis, even when the other axis gains, and keeps the warm cell when nothing was lost
- `test_bench_env_line_spells_home_as_tilde` - `bench_env_line` spells a DASLLAMA_MODELS_DIR under the home as a tilde outside the quotes its space needs, and no home directory survives in the env receipt
- `test_tts_ref_args` - `tts_ref_args` runs the torch arm on the tts venv with one model at the das voice, the asked device, limit, passes and threads, the mlx arm with the mlx engine and no device, and the engine name follows the package
- `test_tts_catalog_seams` - The TTS catalog finds rows by file name only for TTS files, every row carries its fields and a unique file, both engines record under one test key, and the das child and media legs carry the right flags
- `test_tts_reference_output` - The TTS reference output parsers read the BENCH row as summed generation ms and audio seconds for the asked sentence count only, and the VERSIONS field empty when absent and free of a preceding warning line
- `test_tts_corpus_head` - `tts_corpus_head` skips textless sentences, stops at n, returns fewer for a short corpus and none for unparsable JSON, and the committed corpus holds the default sentence count
- `test_tts_seat_verdict` - `tts_seat_verdict` reads none when no seat served, all when every called seat served every call, and partial when any call fell to the CPU or one seat never served beside another
- `test_mlx_lm_reference` - `mlx_lm_bench_args` builds the flat reference argv on the MLX venv with --npl only past one stream, and `mlx_lm_rows` keeps only whole ROW lines with a positive numeric rate
- `test_board_refs_guard` - `board_refs_refusal` refuses a board mint whose CPU leg lacks --ref-clean or Metal leg lacks --ref-stock, and admits a metal-only run, a scratch das-only store and an asr or tts-only run
- `test_gpu_leg_guards` - `gpu_leg_refusal` admits a Vulkan or CUDA leg only alone, off Apple, under its own asks on a build carrying the module, a board mint needs each leg's ref, and `cell_served_on` holds only when every das row stamps that home
- `test_ref_py` - `ref_py` returns the normalized override interpreter when set, else the named venv beside the ASR benches

### test_gguf_quant.das

- `test_gguf_type_sizes` - `ggml_type_bytes` returns the ggml block sizes for K, i-quant, Q8_0 and F16 types and 0 for an unknown type, `ggml_type_name` the upstream spelling, and every KqFmt names its ggml type and block bytes
- `test_gguf_load_declines_unread_types` - Loading a synthetic GGUF whose tensor is Q4_1 panics naming the tensor and its disk type, while the same file at Q8_0 passes the type check and stops later on missing metadata
- `test_gguf_q5_0` - On a synthetic 3-block Q5_0 tensor the f32 reader matches a hand-rolled ggml reference exactly, the Q8 transcode keeps d verbatim and reproduces every value bit for bit, and a src_off slice lands the full run's bytes
- `test_q5k_encoder` - The Q5_K encoder round-trips a scale-laddered input with every 32-element sub-block under 0.15 relative rmse and the 4-byte scale tail zeroed, and encodes an all-zero superblock to exact zeros
- `test_gguf_f32_reader_superblock_types` - For each of nine superblock K-quant and i-quant types over random bytes, `gguf_read_tensor_f32` equals the native transcode-then-dequant value for value, a NaN pair counting as agreement

### test_gguf_shards.das

- `test_shard_name_passthrough` - `gguf_shard_paths` returns the path unchanged and alone for a plain name and for every malformed split spelling: short digits, index 0, index past the count, non-digits, a non-gguf extension
- `test_shard_split_expansion` - `gguf_shard_paths` expands a complete three-shard split from any shard index into every shard in order, and with missing_ok an incomplete split yields an empty list instead of a panic
- `test_shard_mtp_head_sidecar` - `gguf_shard_paths` appends the NextN head as the last shard: the same-named mtp sibling, else the stem Q8_0 head (also for a -UD trunk), or the override exclusively; a missing override attaches nothing and a head never recurses
- `test_safetensors_snapshot` - A synthetic two-file safetensors snapshot reads with sorted shards, an unaligned data start, GGUF-renamed tensors, an 8-bit affine triplet as one tensor, the vision tower dropped, config KVs and llama3 rope factors
- `test_safetensors_moe_snapshot` - A synthetic qwen3_5_moe snapshot loads as qwen35moe with its expert KVs, an exact 8-bit router and expert-major stack transcode, and a stray unmapped layer tensor or a short tensor span refuses the snapshot

### test_gigaam.das

One stage's relative error bar: max |got - want| over max |want|.

- `test_gigaam_ctc` - GigaAM v3 CTC on its f16 carrier matches the upstream package's dumps stage by stage (mel, front, every layer, encoded within 1e-4, then the decode), and the q8 lane's transcript holds 90 percent of the oracle's words while a half-silenced clip does not
- `test_gigaam_kq_lane` - The Q4_K GigaAM carrier loads on the kq lane named k4 with members k4+q8, its transcripts hold the q8 word bar against the f16 lane on the CPU and on the serving GPU tower with no decline, and its Q8_0 seats equal the file's blocks bit for bit
- `test_gigaam_kq_lane_pins` - On the Q4_K carrier the q8 flag leaves the kq lane and transcript unchanged, the facade honors the q8 pin, kq encoder rows sit within 1.5x the pinned q8 lane's distance from the widened carrier, and pinned q8 and f32 lanes transcribe
- `test_gigaam_fp32_pin_load` - The facade fp32 pin on the Q4_K GigaAM carrier loads the widened f32 lane on the CPU image, never a GPU flavor, and still transcribes the clip
- `test_gigaam_kq_other_carriers` - The kq lane serves a mixed Q4_K and Q6_K GigaAM carrier as kq with members k4+k6+q8, whose held staging mints the same transcript, and an all-Q8_0 carrier as q8 with seats equal to the file's blocks, both within the word bar
- `test_gigaam_kq_load_flavor` - Loading the Q4_K GigaAM carrier with the serving tower on lands the kq lane on the GPU flavor where the box's device stands up, else on the CPU image, and the transcript holds the word bar against the f16 lane
- `test_gigaam_kq_refusals` - Over retyped copies of the Q4_K carrier the kq planner refuses a float GEMM among quantized ones, a Q5_1 or NVFP4 seat, and q in Q8_0 beside K-quant k and v, each by name, stages an unchanged copy, and the lane peek tags BF16 and F32 GEMMs as the exact lane
- `test_gigaam_ctc_bakes_no_transducer` - `gigaam_rnnt_dev_bake` on a CTC-head model neither refuses nor places any transducer piece in the device build plan
- `test_gigaam_tower_mm_needs_the_sums` - The `tower_mm` form without Q8_K sums panics on a kq-lane model, naming the form with the sums it must take
- `test_gigaam_seat_index` - Over the v3 geometry `fc_gemm_seat_index` maps each of every layer's ten block GEMM virtual offsets, and the last GEMM's last element, to its seat in layout order
- `test_gigaam_e2e_rnnt` - GigaAM v3 e2e RNNT on its f16 carrier matches the upstream dumps stage by stage within 1e-4 through the decode on two clips, and its q8 lane's transcript holds 90 percent of the oracle's words with a half-silenced control under the bar
- `test_gigaam_e2e_ctc` - GigaAM v3 e2e CTC on its f16 carrier matches the upstream dumps stage by stage within 1e-4 through the decode, and its q8 lane's transcript holds 90 percent of the oracle's words with a half-silenced control under the bar
- `test_gigaam_charwise_rnnt` - GigaAM v3 char-wise RNNT on its f16 carrier matches the upstream dumps stage by stage within 1e-4 through the decode, and its q8 lane's transcript holds 90 percent of the oracle's words with a half-silenced control under the bar
- `test_gigaam_long_form` - A long Russian clip past the cap splits at silences into ascending non-overlapping spans of at most 25 s, one text segment each, whose joined transcript holds 95 percent of the FLEURS references' words in order while the reversed references miss
- `test_gigaam_facade` - Through the ASR facade a decoder GGUF needs its mmproj while the GigaAM carrier loads alone, its caps are Russian segment-timestamped whole-clip, an English session is refused, and transcribe yields the family's own one-segment transcript with a finite log-probability
- `test_gigaam_hparam_refusals` - `gigaam_check_hparams` accepts the v3 CTC and one-layer RNNT headers and refuses, naming the field, a head neither ctc nor rnnt, a two-layer predictor, d_model or ff_dim off the 32 lattice, and an odd head_dim
- `test_gigaam_hparam_clauses` - Every other unsupported GigaAM header field (sample rate, centered STFT, attention, conv norm, window, heads, subsampling, kernels, blank, tokenizer, token count) is refused by its own clause, and `gigaam_check_arch` refuses a llama GGUF
- `test_gigaam_spans` - `gigaam_spans` merges short speech regions under the cap, closes a span when the next region would pass it, cuts a region longer than the cap into ascending cap-sized spans, and yields none for no regions
- `test_gigaam_long_clip_needs_the_vad` - `gigaam_chunks` on a silent clip past the cap panics naming a missing silero VAD weights path, and with the shipped weights returns no span and no refusal
- `test_gigaam_facade_refusals` - The GigaAM facade refuses a translate session at transcribe, `gguf_is_side_file` marks the ASR carrier and an mmproj but not a decoder, and the loader refuses another family's .dlim while mapping the carrier's own image
- `test_gigaam_short_span` - A clip shorter than n_fft makes `gigaam_transcribe` return zero segments, hand out none, report Russian, and not panic
- `test_gigaam_device_decode_twin` - For the e2e and char-wise RNNT carriers on f16 and q8 lanes, the transducer decode on the build's device seat emits the CPU decoder's ids and frames with plog within 1e-5, counted once on the device
- `test_gigaam_ctc_head_metal` - On the Metal seat the GigaAM CTC head, f16 and q8 on both CTC carriers, picks the CPU head's classes but at near-ties with log-sums within the bar and the same ids and transcript, from device and uploaded rows, while a 1.05x louder clip exceeds the bar
- `test_gigaam_ctc_head_oracle` - Over the oracle's encoder rows the GigaAM CTC head, on the CPU and the build's device seat, picks the oracle's argmax but at near-ties, emits tokens within 1e-4 of the oracle's softmax and its exact ids, while zeroing the head's halfwords leaves the oracle's ids
- `test_gigaam_corpus_eval` - The asr_corpus_eval harness on the Q4_K carrier transcribes a FLEURS-layout split up to --limit into one hypothesis row carrying the clip's words, translating with a Bergamot student where present, and refuses an unknown --lane by name

### test_gpu_home.das

the flags a home's installer declares by value, read back: the CUDA home feeds every site in its own form, the Vulkan home does not (the host twin is no witness: the Vulkan entry installs it, the CUDA home's arm does)

- `test_gpu_home` - The GPU home is the environment's spelling with the arm registrant and site-feed flags following it, unknown names are refused, and switching to the build's other home lands with one shared install before the tier arms and is refused after
- `test_stream_pinned_free_follows_the_maker` - With fake allocators registered for both homes, the expert cache frees a pinned buffer through the free of the home that made it, never the other, and a refused buffer with null mapping through neither
- `test_dn_slot_drop_keeps_the_ring_image` - A recurrent slot's owner record keeps the ring image it last advanced onto when dropped, forgetting its owner and addresses, so a parked claim's checkpoint copies the right parity; a new bind resets it

### test_gpu_model_swap.das

- `test_gpu_drop_before_load_keeps_request` - The pre-load drop on an installed GPU tier clears a stale model's dense marks while keeping this load's MoE layer-count request
- `test_gpu_marks_carry_ple_projection` - Saving the GPU model marks turns the per-layer-embedding projection arm off and restoring them turns it back on

- `test_gpu_slot_swap` - On TinyLlama Q8_0 a resident run hydrated and dropped mid-stream continues on the CPU, and two drop and re-arm cycles each emit the straight-through resident control trajectory token for token
