### test_tts_pocket.das

- `test_pocket_tokenizer` - The Pocket unigram tokenizer encodes all 200 prepared corpus sentences and the byte-fallback probes id for id with the reference package and decodes them back, never encodes typed control text to EOS, and panics on an out-of-vocab unk id
- `test_prepare_pocket_text` - `prepare_pocket_text` matches the reference's prepared string and frames-after-EOS on all 200 corpus rows and the fixture probes, applies the terminal-mark and word-count rules, and panics on blank text while the chunker yields none
- `test_pocket_parity` - On the f32 CPU lane the Pocket codec decoder and encoder hold 2e-3 of the oracle's peak, and the voice prompt's frame count and per-layer KV rows hold 5e-3, against the oracle dumps
- `test_pocket_codec_stream` - The windowed Pocket codec decode and encode match the whole-run output within 1e-5 absolute at window 1 and the default, using under half the scratch, and after `pocket_release_scratch` frees every buffer the next decode matches again
- `test_pocket_frames` - Teacher-forced on the oracle's noise and frames, Pocket reproduces the token and frame counts, and the flow head, conditioning, EOS logits and latents hold 5e-3 of the oracle's peak, the waveform 8e-3
- `test_pocket_codec_metal` - The Pocket codec seat on the GPU tower, f32 lane, holds rel-l2 1e-5 of the CPU chain over the oracle's latents with one encode a call, and with the knob off the CPU result is bit-equal and the decline recorded
- `test_pocket_codec_metal_served` - The Pocket codec seat on the served planes of the stocked q8 and kq files holds rel-l2 2e-1 of each file's own CPU chain over the oracle's latents, served once a call, with one-sample and x3-scaled controls
- `test_pocket_prompt_rules` - `tts_pk_prompt_admit` refuses an empty prompt, a cache count off the layers, rows past capacity and a capacity past the keys, and the prompt residency record is spent by one take and missed on any changed build, rows, embedding or fill
- `test_pocket_seat_stats` - `pocket_gpu_stats` panics naming an unknown seat key, and `pocket_gpu_seats` lists codec, frames, prompt in dispatch order, each reading counters with served never above calls
- `test_pocket_prompt_gpu` - The Pocket prompt seat's per-layer K/V rows hold rel-l2 1e-5 of the CPU chain on the f32 lane and 5e-2 on the q8 and kq served planes, one call and encode, knob-off bit-equal, with one-element and rotated-text controls
- `test_pocket_frames_metal` - The Pocket frames seat on the tower, f32 lane, teacher-forced holds latents, conditioning and EOS at rel-l2 2e-5 of the CPU chain with the RNG ending equal, the free run 5e-3, batches of 3 too, and an empty driver record reaches no hook
- `test_pocket_frames_metal_served` - The Pocket frames seat on the q8 and kq served planes, teacher-forced for one case a voice, makes the CPU chain's frame count with latents within rel-l2 1e-1 of each file's own CPU chain, served once with one encode a batch
- `test_pocket_frames_after_model_drop` - After the LLM tier's `moe_gpu_drop_model` in the same process, the Pocket q8 frames seat serves again and holds the same bar against the CPU chain at the same frame count as before the drop
- `test_pocket_synthesis_metal` - Pocket served-lane synthesis serves every seat once a chunk with the knob on and declines each with it off, encoding more than once a chunk, both legs finite and over a second of speech
- `test_pocket_q8_lane` - On the pinned q8 lane the Pocket backbone GEMMs serve q8 and codec convs f32, teacher-forced latents hold rel-l2 0.5 of the f32 oracle with an rms-shift control, and the free run lands within 4 frames of the oracle with speech
- `test_pocket_q8_file` - The published Q8_0 Pocket file loads every backbone GEMM as q8 with codec convs f32, and its teacher-forced latents hold rel-l2 5e-2 of the f16 file's on both the q8 lane and the dequantized f32 lane
- `test_pocket_kq_file` - The K-quant Pocket file serves Q4_K planes unpinned, Q8_0 pinned q8 and f32 pinned f32; its kq lane holds rel-l2 5e-2 of the q8 and exact lanes, the Q8_0 head 2e-2 of the oracle, and a roster-name clone keeps 19 voices and speaks
- `test_pocket_languages` - Each of the five other-language Pocket Q8_0 files reports its code and one default voice, tokenizes its corpus and probes id for id with the reference, holds teacher-forced latents at rel-l2 0.5 within 2 frames, and speaks through the facade
- `test_pocket_small_models` - Each small Pocket model (18M, 7M, 2M) loads its declared shape and driver rules, refuses each broken frames-admission clause, keeps decimals in one chunk, holds the oracle's stage bars and GPU seat bars, and its published file tokenizes exactly and speaks
- `test_pocket_small_refl` - Each stocked reward-tuned small Pocket twin reports a _refl_2026-10 config with the six-frame EOS guard and speaks a sentence as finite audio with rms above 0.01
- `test_pocket_facade` - Pocket through the facade reports a cloning English model with 19 voices and no speed, matches the reference chunker, speaks 1 to 8 seconds, clones a voice from the checked-in clip, and refuses unknown voice, speed, phonemes, wrong rate and over-long clips by name
- `test_pocket_no_encoder` - A one-voice Pocket file without the codec encoder needs no packs, does not clone, speaks stuart_bell from stored frames and refuses a clip naming the missing encoder, and the 18M one-voice twin speaks bit-identical samples to the full 18M-kq file
- `test_pocket_quiet_floor` - On the kq file the q8 lane's quiet floor (the quietest twentieth of differenced 100 ms windows) sits within 6 dB of the f32 lane's, while the f32 render with a -60 dBFS hiss mixed in lands past that bar
- `test_pocket_long_chunk` - An unsplittable chunk past POCKET_MAX_TOKENS speaks instead of panicking, the GPU codec seat declining it by shape, the voice's caches grow to the chunk's need, and a following short sentence on the same voice still speaks
- `test_pocket_prepared_prompt_transfer` - A voice prompt prepared on a cloning Pocket file survives JSON and registers lazily on an encoder-less file, a flipped latent-space id refuses it, it conditions an 18M model that speaks, and the small model trims a padded clip to end on a pause
- `test_pocket_eos_guard` - `pocket_eos_stops` ignores an over-threshold EOS logit before min_frames_before_eos, pins EOS at the first allowed frame and stops two frames later, pins immediately with no guard, and ignores under-threshold logits
- `test_pocket_latent_space_fingerprint` - `pocket_latent_space_id` is stable for the same space and changes when any one input - sample rate, latent width, frame length, latent mean or deviation - changes
- `test_pocket_shape_admission` - `tts_pk_tf_ok` admits a 64-wide head and grouped 32-wide heads at the 32 floor, and refuses each clause alone: off-lattice widths, no KV head, non-multiple query heads, mismatched attention width, heads under the floor, not dividing or past hs

### test_tts_postag.das

- `test_word_features` - `pos_norm_word` folds tokens to the trainer's classes (hyphen not leading, year, digits, lower case) and `pos_word_shape` emits case shapes with the d, h, q suffixes in order, a leading hyphen not counting
- `test_tokenizer_split_rules` - With an empty exception table `pos_tokenize` splits dash, comma, colon and case-changing period infixes between letters but not before digits, and loading a missing tagger pack panics
- `test_tokenizer` - The loaded POS tokenizer matches the reference tokenizer token for token, spacing included, on all 200 corpus sentences, and splits contractions, abbreviations, dashes and possessives exactly on extra shapes
- `test_tagger` - The packed POS tagger meets its header floors, agrees with the reference tagger on at least 96 percent of corpus tokens and 80 percent of heteronym words, tags a pinned sentence exactly, and loads under 150 ms

### test_tts_textnorm.das

- `test_number_words` - The English number readers give exact words for cardinals up to billions and negatives, decimals digit by digit, ordinals, and years read as pairs, hundreds or full numbers
- `test_upstream_pipeline_shapes` - `normalize_text` reproduces the reference normalizer's own examples exactly: money, percentages, ordinals, clock times, ranges, versions, HTML, URLs and emails, abbreviations, dates and whitespace
- `test_upstream_defects_fixed` - `normalize_text` gives the corrected reading for each upstream normalizer defect: bare commas, h:mm:ss, fractions, glued units, pence, degrees, decades, apostrophes, sentence-final versions, -ieth ordinals, dollar plurals, p.m., glued digits
- `test_number_width_and_units` - A digit run past 18 digits reads digit by digit while 18 digits read as a cardinal, `digit_string_value` holds values past 2^31, and exactly one of a unit reads singular, other counts plural
- `test_normalizer_arms` - `normalize_text` spells www and scheme URLs as the reference does, reads ordinal edges up to millionth, and wraps a 24-hour time past noon only when a meridiem follows
- `test_codepoint_codec` - `utf8_to_cpts` passes a malformed lead byte through as itself and still decodes the next byte, well-formed codepoints round-trip, and `cpts_to_utf8` maps values outside 0..U+10FFFF to U+FFFD
- `test_corpus` - `normalize_text` matches the reference normalizer's output, or the fixture's corrected form where one is carried, on all 200 corpus sentences, and is idempotent on each
- `test_unicode` - `cpt_is_letter`, `cpt_is_number` and `cpt_is_whitespace` classify ASCII and non-ASCII codepoints (A-umlaut, one-half, ideographic space) as the upstream flags do, and a multi-byte UTF-8 word round-trips

### test_tts_textnorm_ru.das

- `test_number_words_ru` - The Russian number readers give exact words: cardinals with gender and scale-word agreement, `plural_ru` picking the right form by count, ordinals inflected on the last word, and decimals with the fraction-width denominator
- `test_normalize_ru` - `normalize_text_ru` expands years, dates, clock times, ordinal suffixes, units, percentages, money, abbreviations and symbols with grammatical agreement into exact pinned sentences, and is a fixed point on its own output
- `test_spoken_thousand_ru` - a thousand at the head of a number reads тысяча, the way it is said; a count of thousands ending in one keeps its одна
- `test_unit_before_sentence_dot_ru` - a unit abbreviation after a number reads as the unit even when its dot ends the sentence, never as the abbreviation it spells alone
- `test_cardinal_case_ru` - a cardinal after a preposition or a governing word takes the case it governs; a plural noun after в or на makes it prepositional, after с instrumental
- `test_case_from_dictionary_ru` - the noun dictionary, a verb's dative or instrumental, a quantity word and the noun before an inverted approximation give a cardinal the gender and case its noun's ending cannot
- `test_ranges_ru` - the halves of a date or year range take the forms their prepositions and their noun ask for; a range of bare years with no preposition and no noun stays cardinal
- `test_roman_ru` - a Roman numeral after a name or before век reads as an ordinal in the form they ask for; with nothing numbering it, a numeral of two letters or more under forty reads as a cardinal; a Roman letter inside a Latin word stays
- `test_roman_gate_ru` - a regnal or section numeral is spelled with I, V and X and is at most forty, a century at most twenty-one; Latin capitals that fail the gate stay as written
- `test_roman_suffix_ru` - a Roman numeral with an ordinal suffix reads as the ordinal in the suffix's form, the way an Arabic one does
- `test_clock_times_ru` - a clock time reads with its часов and минут in the case the word before it asks for; a set score in a list after a match score is not a time
- `test_measures_ru` - square, cubic and per-time units read whole, agreeing with the count and its case; a decimal takes the genitive singular, except a half: пол, полтора, с половиной
- `test_fractions_ru` - fractions read with their denominator as an ordinal: одна вторая, три четвёртых, a whole part with целых; before a unit or a word written out a half, a quarter or a third reads as a word (полчаса, полстакана, четверть века, полторы тонны); a minus before a fraction reads минус; a season or a day pair is no fraction
- `test_phones_ru` - a telephone number or an ISBN reads in groups with a pause between them; a number with a leading zero reads digit by digit
- `test_phone_gate_ru` - a hyphenated run is no telephone number when it has the shape of a date - four digits first, then a one-digit group - or two four-digit groups, unless an area code or a book number marks it
- `test_money_ru` - money: one or two fraction digits as the minor unit, the currency after a scale word in the genitive plural, a half of a scale as с половиной, the ISO codes as currencies

### test_tts_voice_prompts.das

- `test_prepared_voice_registration_is_owned_and_transactional` - `tts_register_voice_prompt` copies the caller's latents, re-registering a name evicts its old PCM and conditioning state, the voice reaches caps and lookup, and a refused prompt or empty name leaves the existing voice intact
- `test_prepared_voice_prompt_rejects_incompatible_data` - A voice prompt with a wrong kind, version, family, latent space, rate, width or stride, empty, partial or over-60-second latents, or a NaN, infinite or out-of-bound value is invalid and registers nothing, while exactly 60 seconds is accepted
- `test_prepared_voice_requires_valid_reference` - `tts_prepare_voice_prompt` panics for a non-Pocket model, a model without the encoder, a reference at the wrong rate, an empty clip, or a clip past 60 seconds

### test_vad.das

- `test_vad_forward_lcg` - Silero VAD on a deterministic LCG signal yields 10 per-frame probabilities each within 1e-3 of the values frozen from onnxruntime op15
- `test_vad_empty_clip` - An empty clip yields no probability from `vad_probs` or `vad_probs_cpu`, no speech region, and no streaming event, also with the stream GPU lever on
- `test_vad_segments_jfk` - `find_speech_timestamps` on jfk.wav returns exactly the four segments silero get_speech_timestamps gives, start and end sample for sample
- `test_vad_gpu_twin` - The GPU VAD seat serves every chunk with probabilities within 1e-5 absolute of the CPU chunk step (a silenced-chunk control must exceed it), streams the CPU feed's exact events, and segments jfk and ru_long to the CPU's exact regions
- `test_vad_metal_declines` - The Metal VAD seat declines once per call on its knob, a slab-less model, a sub-1024-lane pipeline and an untakeable scratch, stepping no device chunk and answering the CPU probabilities bit for bit, then serves again
- `test_vad_vulkan_declines` - The Vulkan VAD seat declines once per call on its knob, a slab-less model, no tile family, and a slab or scratch past the storage range, answering the CPU probabilities bit for bit, then serves on a rebuilt scratch
- `test_vad_cuda_declines` - The CUDA VAD seat declines once per call on its knob, a slab-less model, a failed class build and a failed allocation, answering the CPU probabilities bit for bit, then serves on a rebuilt resident

### test_vision.das

- `test_vision_geometry` - `vision_target_size` at gemma4's 48 px alignment reproduces the mtmd oracle's target sizes including the half-away rounding tie, token counts match, and extreme aspects or huge sources stay inside the token budget without int32 wrap
- `test_vision_preproc_bit_exact` - Gemma4 vision preprocessing (target size, letterbox, normalize) of synthetic fixtures hashes FNV-1a 64 bit-identical to the mtmd oracle's planes across square, non-square, upscale, downscale and rounding-tie cases
- `test_vision_geometry_qwen` - `vision_target_size` at the qwen towers' 32 px alignment and 8..4096 token budget reproduces the oracle table including the rounding tie and beta downscale, and extreme aspects stay within budget
- `test_vision_preproc_bit_exact_qwen` - Qwen vision preprocessing with mean and std 0.5 hashes FNV-1a 64 bit-identical to the oracle's normalized planes for aligned, nearest-multiple, rounding-tie, small-grid and letterboxed downscale fixtures
- `test_vision_normalize3_channels` - `vision_normalize3` applies each channel's own mean and std within 1e-6 of the formula, so swapping the channel parameters would move the values
- `test_vision_io_roundtrip` - PNG bytes and a `dump_image_png` file decode back through `load_image_rgb` to the exact source RGB, `write_image_ppm` writes the exact header and bytes, and a zero-size image refuses to write
- `test_vision_io_guards` - `load_image_rgb` returns a zero-size image for empty, garbage or missing input and for anything over max_pixels decided from the header alone, and `probe_image_size` reads dimensions from a pixel-less header
- `test_vision_letterbox_probes` - `vision_letterbox` pads a portrait image with black corners around exact content, copies an identity-size image byte for byte, and upscales a checkerboard corner-aligned with the oracle's 138 center value

- `test_vision_chat_e2b` - Through the gemma4v E2B tower the mmproj sniffs as gemma4v at 48 px, a carrier with no vision arm is refused at create, the cats turn splices 130 rows between the image markers, and the greedy caption names the cats
- `test_vision_chat_e2b_nothink` - The E2B Q4_K_M image turn with thinking off under the sampled preset ends on a stop before the budget, files any leading thought block as reasoning, and leaves a cats answer with no channel marker in the content and the history
- `test_vision_chat_gemma3` - The gemma-3-4b SigLIP pair sniffs as gemma3v at 56 px, splices the fixed 256 rows between start_of_image and end_of_image, and greedily captions the cats in over 40 characters
- `test_vision_chat_gemma3_12b` - The gemma-3-12b pair sniffs as gemma3v with the 3840-wide projection, splices the fixed 256 image rows, and greedily captions the cats in over 40 characters

- `test_vision_chat_deepstack` - The Qwen3-VL 4B deepstack turn carries 10240-wide rows (1+3 taps of 2560) into the chat and captions the cats, and zeroing the deepstack slices moves the decoder's logits by over 1e-2
- `test_vision_chat_rows_seam` - Pre-encoded wide rows fed to a plain chat through `add_user_image_rows_` produce the embedder chat's greedy reply token for token, and narrow rows on a deepstack decoder or a second image before respond panic
- `test_vision_chat_qwen25o` - The Qwen2.5-Omni turn loads contiguous qwen2vl MROPE sections, sniffs qwen25v at 2048 wide, splices 391 rows on a 23x17 grid, captions the cats, and sets the rope delta to 23 - 391
- `test_render_image_span_qwen25o` - A plain Qwen2.5-Omni chat with no embedder renders an image span whose head closes on the vocab's own vision_bos marker id

- `test_vision_embedder_none` - A default VisionEmbedder reports zero width, zero alignment, no family and the f32 stamp and panics on encode, and `load_vision_embedder` panics on a missing file and on an audio-only mmproj

### test_vulkan_dec_tail.das

The per-op tier's decode attention block and the decode FFN tail against a CPU reference: two attention quads (layers A and B), one expert stack pair, two positions, in both acts forms (K-quant quads feed Q8_K, q8 quads feed Q8_0). Token flow per position: block(A) -> host residual -> tail(FFN A + combine + B's feed on the device) -> block(B) collects the residual row. Weights are synthetic stacks (the fixtures).

- `test_vulkan_dec_span_cache` - span_args_current holds the cached span arguments current only for the carrier that filled them, refusing a same-layout carrier, another suffix start or another suffix length
- `test_vulkan_dec_span` - The whole-token decode span (two k4 attention layers, device router and top-k, routed FFN) matches a CPU reference routed by moe_select_core within 1e-3 of the row max at two positions, and vulkan_moe_span registers
- `test_vulkan_dec_span_shexp` - The decode span with a shared q8 expert, sigmoid-gated and ungated, matches the CPU residual row within 1e-3 of the row max at two positions, and the reference without the shared expert misses the device row
- `test_vulkan_shexp_mixed_forms` - shexp_gpu_gemms reads a q8 gate on Q8_0, a k4 up on Q8_K and a k6 down, matching the per-image reference within 1e-3 of the row max at 1 and 3 rows, every row counted; the k4 up fed Q8_0 misses (control)
- `test_vulkan_dense_ffn_mixed_forms` - ffn_gpu_gemms runs a q51 gate on Q8_0, a k4 up on Q8_K and a k6 down, matching the engine scalar dots within 1e-3 of the row max at 1 and 3 rows; the k4 up fed the gate Q8_0 image misses (control)
- `test_vulkan_routed_mx4_form` - matmul_moe_gpu_ffn over native-MXFP4 expert stacks matches the engine mx4 scalar dot within 1e-3 of the row max on decode and batch arms, plain and under gpt-oss bias plus clamped swiglu, which the plain reference misses
- `test_vulkan_routed_two_forms` - matmul_moe_gpu_ffn with a q8 gate stack on Q8_0 and a k4 up stack on the second Q8_K image matches the reference within 1e-3 of the row max on decode and batch arms; up stacks fed the Q8_0 image miss
- `test_vulkan_heat_mx4_form` - The heat pool serves the two pinned experts of a top-k of three over streamed MXFP4 stacks on the async chain, under gpt-oss biased clamped swiglu, within 1e-3 of the row max; the plain reference misses
- `test_vulkan_dec_tail` - The decode attention block and FFN tail match the CPU reference within 1e-3 of the row max for k4, q8 and biased q8 quad pairs, both hydrate arms, and a k4 and q8 quad at one plane offset

### test_vulkan_host_twin.das

- `test_host_twin_superblock` - On the fifteen superblock formats the host twin over the engine gather of a planar stack into the device layout matches the planar kernels within 1e-4 relative, and they match a plain dequantized dot
- `test_host_twin_block32` - On the four per-32 formats, mx4 and q8 the host twin over the gathered device planes matches the planar kernels within 1e-4 relative, and the planar kernels match a plain dequantized dot
- `test_host_rm_q8` - The row-major q8 GEMV `q8q8_rm_gemv_gen` over the engine gathered device planes matches the planar q8 kernel within 1e-4 relative on eight rows off the superblock lattice
- `test_host_rm_block32` - The row-major GEMVs for iq4nl32, q4032, q51, q5032 and mx4 over the gathered device planes match the planar kernels within 1e-4 relative on 22-block rows
- `test_host_rm_superblock` - The row-major GEMVs of the fifteen superblock formats under the Q8_K activation match the planar kernels within 1e-4 relative over the gathered device planes on five-superblock rows
- `test_host_rm_tile4` - For every format the discrete homes stamp, the row-major four-token tile over the gathered device planes matches the planar kernels a token, four scaled activation rows, within 1e-4 relative

### test_vulkan_kernels.das

The Vulkan tier's kernel classes against their CPU oracles, one cell a class family: the decode GEMVs, the acts, requants and combines, the rope and K/V stores, the routing and schedules, the router GEMV's stamps (f32, bf16 word pairs, bf16 halfwords at an odd dim), the per-layer-embedding classes and the device roster; the GEMM tiles are `test_vulkan_kernels_gemm.das`, the attention classes `test_vulkan_kernels_attn.das`. Skips: every cell without dasVulkan or a Vulkan device; the cm2 arms off a coopmat2 device created in cm2 mode; a class rail a device declines.

- `test_vkd_class_dispatch` - The toy class kernel dispatched through the generated vk_dispatch surface equals the same method run on the CPU bit for bit on 250 lanes, the CPU loop overrunning the range so the in-kernel guard is tested
- `test_vkd_subgroup_width` - Every invocation of a class pipeline reads gl_SubgroupSize equal to the width the tier records, the device own width or the pin where the two differ, over 256 lanes
- `test_vkd_readonly_stamp` - In the toy kernel SPIR-V the lens decorates NonWritable on the binding the kernel only reads and not on the one it writes, exactly one of the two
- `test_vkd_fa_stamp_words` - In the kept SPIR-V of the flash stamps at heads 64 to 512 the KHR arm alone declares its four Workgroup tiles and the KHR capability, the cm2 arm none and only NV cooperative-matrix capabilities
- `test_vkd_fa_stamp_refusals` - The flash ensure and encode ladders panic before device work on a softcap or gated stamp off head 256, a head size no stamp serves, KHR head 96, and a sink stamp off head 64 or with a softcap
- `test_vkd_lens_readonly_gate` - A compile-only child declaring readonly on a binding its vk_dispatch kernel writes fails with an error naming the member and binding, while the twin without the qualifier compiles
- `test_vkd_lens_kernel_prefix_gate` - A compile-only child whose vk_dispatch kernel= prefix matches two spirv_kernel methods fails with an error counting the matches, while the exact method name compiles
- `test_vkd_ext_roster` - Every device-init roster entry is named once, says what rides on it and names only a Vulkan-tier knob, and each arming field (coopmat, cm2, decvec, ReBAR, subgroup pin) reads as its entry says
- `test_vkd_direct_decode` - A spirv_decode method called directly from a kernel body on the plane element computes on the device bit for bit what the same method computes on the CPU over two q8-shaped blocks
- `test_vkd_ar_class` - The cls_ar add-rms class equals the shipped vk_add_rms seam bit for bit on the normed row and residual, and with the gpt-oss output bias partner it equals the seam fed the pre-added partner and the CPU oracle within 2e-3
- `test_vkd_ple_finish` - PleFinish rewrites six 256-wide side slices in place as the CPU finish normed a slice at a time within 2e-3, the one-norm-over-every-slice form differing as control
- `test_vkd_cls_epi_rows` - The classifier epilogue over four 1000-wide logits rows in one dispatch equals the one-row dispatch bit for bit, every logit within 1e-4 of the CPU softcap and every suppressed id pinned on every row
- `test_vkd_cls_argmax` - The two-pass device argmax picks the host first maximum on every row at 262144 and 1000 vocab: ties on the lower id, an all-equal or all-NaN row at id 0, NaN and -inf lanes skipped
- `test_vkd_cls_select` - cls_select lands per row the ids at or above the 1024th largest logit with their logits, max and denominator as select_rows_oracle does at 262144 and 1000 vocab, ties, overflow, NaN rows and the recent window included
- `test_vkd_cls_ar_row0` - cls_ar with a row base equals the vk_add_rms seam bit for bit on the rows from row0, the row below keeping its residual and the normed sentinel
- `test_vkd_actf16_base` - actf16 dispatched at an element base writes bit for bit the halves the same row dispatched from zero writes, and the halves below the base keep their sentinel
- `test_vkd_act_gelu_past_clamp` - The tanh GELU act on gate values out to 300 matches the CPU form within 2e-3 with every half finite, and every Tanh in the actf16 SPIR-V reads an FClamp result
- `test_vkd_actf16_strided` - actf16 over strided side rows (ubase, ustride, ulen) matches gelu of the gate times the layer side slice within 2e-3, and with no stride reads the contiguous row from ubase, which misses the strided form
- `test_vkd_kq_gemv_family` - The decode GEMV of all fifteen kq leaf formats matches the class CPU oracle within 2e-3 at 1, 2 and 20 superblocks a row and at every lane split, and the oracle matches the float dequant witness where one exists
- `test_vkd_emb_gather_family` - The token-table gather of all fifteen superblock formats matches the class lane decode within 2e-3 on three ids past a lead row and one host-staged row, each gathered row dotting to the float GEMV within 1e-3
- `test_vkd_emb_gather_b32` - The per-32 token-table gathers for q51, iq4nl32, q4032 and q5032 match the engine plane dequant under the embed scale within 2e-3, three ids past a lead row and one host-staged row
- `test_vkd_kq_gemv_k4_gu` - The fused kq gate and up GEMV with gelu and Q8_0 requant (k4, iq4xs, iq3s4, iq2s) matches the CPU chain, quants within a step at every lane split, and the three-kernel path byte for byte
- `test_vkd_act_family` - The Q8_0 and Q8_K act requants under silu, clamped swiglu and strided gelu match the CPU oracle (quants within a step, scales within 2e-3), the biased swiglu twins need their bias rows, and the combine matches
- `test_vkd_rope_family` - The rope and K/V store with q/k/v bias past a pad matches the NEOX table rope oracle within 2e-3 on q in place and both mirrors, and qk_rms matches the per-head rms oracle within 2e-3
- `test_vkd_requant_family` - The fused add-rms Q8_0 requant matches the CPU chain (quants within a step, scales and residual within 2e-3), with and without the bias partner, its Q8_K and row-storing stamps agree, and the plain Q8_K requant is bit-exact
- `test_vkd_q51_gemv` - The q51 decode GEMV over Q8_0 activations matches the scalar dot within 2e-3 at 704 and 1408 wide, and its summed twin folds one, two and four token rows of two weighted slots, wider rows bit for bit
- `test_vkd_iq4nl32_gemv` - The iq4nl32 decode GEMV over Q8_0 activations matches the scalar dot within 2e-3 at 640 and 1280 wide, and its summed twin folds one, two and four token rows of two weighted slots
- `test_vkd_q4032_gemv` - The q4032 decode GEMV over Q8_0 activations matches the scalar dot within 2e-3 at 640 and 896 wide, and its summed twin folds one, two and four token rows of two weighted slots
- `test_vkd_q5032_gemv` - The q5032 decode GEMV over Q8_0 activations matches the scalar dot within 2e-3 at 896 and 1408 wide, and its summed twin folds one, two and four token rows of two weighted slots
- `test_vkd_q5032_float_witness` - The q5032 scalar dot the GEMV cells use as oracle matches the plane-dequant float witness within 1e-4 over 44 hashed blocks, and zeroing the qh words moves the witness past 1e-3
- `test_vkd_mx4_gemv` - The mx4 decode GEMV over Q8_0 activations matches the scalar dot within 2e-3 at 704 and gpt-oss 2880 wide, and its summed twin folds one, two and four token rows of two weighted slots
- `test_vkd_mx4_gemv_gu` - The fused mx4 gate and up GEMV with act and Q8_0 requant matches the scalar dots (gate rows within 2e-3, quants within a step), biased clamped swiglu and plain silu, and the split path byte for byte
- `test_vkd_q8_gemv_gu` - The fused q8 gate and up GEMV with act and Q8_0 requant matches the CPU chain, scales matching and quants within a step, under gelu at 36 blocks deep and silu and clamped swiglu at 16
- `test_vkd_q8_gemv_ar` - The q8 GEMV with the residual step as its last workgroup epilogue matches the CPU chain on the residual row and Q8_0 blocks for sandwich, raw, plain and biased steps at several widths, the counter back at zero
- `test_vkd_q8_gemv_ar_row_twin` - The q8 GEMV epilogue residual step equals the cls_ar_rq_b row kernel fed the same y row bit for bit on the residual row, scales and quants, sandwich and plain steps at gemma widths
- `test_vkd_q8_gemv_gu_n` - The N-column fused q8 gate-up stamps at 1 to 11 columns equal the one-row kernel run a column at a time word for word, slots past the last column untouched, and the one-row rows match the CPU chain
- `test_vkd_q8_gemv_pleact` - The fused per-layer-embedding gelu act, Q8_0 requant and q8 proj GEMV matches the CPU chain within the dot envelope bar at 256 and 128 wide, and its N-column form equals the one-row dispatches bit for bit
- `test_vkd_q8_gemv_pair` - The q8 decode GEMV over two regions of three rows at 512 wide matches the q8 GEMM oracle within 2e-3, unwritten rows read against the sentinel, a poisoned element reddening the bar
- `test_vkd_gemv_ncol` - For every format the discrete homes stamp, the N-column decode GEMV at 1 to 12 columns equals its one-column class column by column bit for bit, q8 row-pair stamps included, the one-column rows within 2e-3 of the oracle
- `test_vkd_cvt_family` - The deltanet Q8_0 requant at an input offset matches the CPU requant bit-exact, and the f16 converters (gelu act, plain convert, clamped swiglu act) match the f32 oracle through their halves within 2e-3
- `test_vkd_qkn_rope_window` - The window form of qkn_rope_cls over three rows past two lead rows at positions 7 to 9 equals its token-rows form bit for bit on q and both mirrors, the lead q rows untouched
- `test_vkd_rope_b_pair` - The batched rope and K/V store (split and merged k|v rows, biased, and at a row base past poison rows) and the fused qk-norm rope store match the CPU oracle within 2e-3, the N-row qkn form bit for bit
- `test_vkd_at_prep` - The attention prep class run as the q and k passes matches the CPU oracle within 2e-3: gated q deinterleave, projection bias, per-head qk rms, partial NEOX rope, the k panel at absolute rows
- `test_vkd_hc_seams` - The hyper-connection seams match their CPU forms within 2e-3: grouped rms with a per-stream gamma at a site offset, silu(lo / hc) Q8_0 requant within a quant step, the gated stream mean, and the scatter on its four flag paths
- `test_vkd_hc_rows` - The window forms of the hyper-connection seams (hc_init copies, cat2 exact, hc_norm over rows and from row0, hc_mix and hc_comb over rows) match the one-row CPU form a row at a time within 2e-3, rows outside untouched
- `test_vkd_ple_side` - The n-gram side input gate and conv match the CPU form within 2e-3 inside and under the taps reach, the ring slot written and others kept, in the window panel form and the verify form committing rows
- `test_vkd_dn_cap_tail` - dn_cap_tail writes for two captures in one dispatch, one past the taps and one under them reading the entry image, bit for bit the ring hand-off oracle, the words between the images keeping their sentinel
- `test_vkd_dn_tail` - dn_tail writes the per-channel ring bit for bit as the CPU form at 5, 3, 2 and 1 window rows over 200 channels, short windows reading the entry image, and differs from the zero-history ring
- `test_vkd_dn_rows_base` - dn_conv and dn_scan at a row base past zero equal the row-0 dispatch bit for bit, lead rows untouched; a half-run capture equals the half-only scan exactly, and the chunked scan holds 1e-2 of peak
- `test_vkd_dn_family` - The deltanet conv, fused step and two-phase scan match their CPU oracles within 2e-3 at heads 64 and 128, the chunked scan holds its bar over 70 rows, and the sigmoid out-gate stamps miss the silu oracle
- `test_vkd_dn_step_rows_sameslot` - The fused deltanet step over three rows of one slot, a dispatch a row, equals the one-row dispatch chained on the state each row left, bit for bit on o rows, state and both ring images, at ds 64 and 128
- `test_vkd_dn_step_rows` - The fused deltanet step over two rows in two region slots equals the one-row dispatch a row at a time bit for bit on each o row, slot state and both ring images, at ds 64 and 128, q8 and f32 o
- `test_vkd_dn_ba` - The prefill f32 beta and alpha GEMM dn_ba matches the CPU dot over the f32 weight rows within 1e-3 at 21 and 40 rows from a row base of 64, only written positions compared
- `test_vkd_dn_9b_scan` - The deltanet scan at the 9B geometry (32 heads, ds 128) matches the sequential CPU delta rule within 1e-2 of the peak at 512 rows, one row and the whole DN_WINDOW, the header kept
- `test_vkd_dn_scan_narrow` - The deltanet scan at a narrow ds 32 state over 64 rows, idle lanes clamped, matches the sequential CPU delta rule within 1e-2 of the peak, the header ahead of the o rows kept
- `test_vkd_dn_9b_ba` - dn_ba at the 9B geometry (dim 4096, 32 heads, 512 rows) from the second layer row base matches the CPU dot within 1e-3, a poisoned beta output reddening the bar
- `test_vkd_router_gemv_bf16` - The bf16 router GEMV matches the CPU dot within 1e-3 at a row and output base, in the two-base form with the gap untouched, with the rms norm folded in, and under an output scale, each unfolded form missing
- `test_vkd_router_gemv_f32_ba` - The f32 router GEMV in its two-base form lands the beta and alpha rows within 1e-3 of the CPU dot at one and three columns, the words between the two bases untouched
- `test_vkd_kv16_writers` - The f16-mirror writer stamps (rope_kv, batched rope_kv_b, qkn_rope) land K and V on the half grid within 2e-3 of the CPU oracle, with and without the q/k/v bias past a pad
- `test_vkd_emb_gather_q8_f32` - The q8 token-table gather equals the CPU dequant then embed scale bit for bit (the folded-scale order reading apart) and the f32 gather the scaled table rows, an EMB_ID_HOST row copying the staged host row
- `test_vkd_hot_combine` - The hot pool combine with its slot window at 1 to k adds the hit rows under their weights to the host row within 1e-3 at width 300, zero-weight NaN rows skipped, and the window at 0 loses the host row
- `test_vkd_moe_gather_row` - The by-row f16 gather over a nine-row window of 21 bucket rows at widths 100, 256 and 300 lands each grid entry position row as halves within 1e-3 of the peak, the two slack rows keeping their sentinel
- `test_vkd_combine_row` - The by-row combine adds each window row weighted down row onto its position within 1e-5 of the peak at widths 100, 256 and 300, an unreached position untouched, and at a region base the chunk-row-0 read misses
- `test_vkd_dec_combine_pair` - The decode combine classes (routed sum, routed plus shared row gated and ungated) match the CPU sum within 1e-3 at width 300, the gate moving the shared row off unit weight
- `test_vkd_ar_rq_fused` - The fused add-rms Q8_0 requant cls_ar_rq_b over six 128-wide rows equals the split cls_ar plus cls_dn_rq pair bit for bit on quant words, scales and the residual row
- `test_vkd_ar_f16_fused` - The fused add-rms f16 store cls_ar_f16_b over six 128-wide rows equals the split cls_ar plus clamp-convert pair bit for bit on the half rows and the residual row
- `test_vkd_topk_n` - The N-row top-k over four rows equals the one-row top-k bit for bit and the host select, plain and under the router bias; the two-deep stamp does so over 512 experts at ten picks, where the one-deep stamp misses
- `test_vkd_ple_act_f32` - PleActF32 computes gelu of the gate times the layer slice of strided side rows within 2e-3 of the CPU form over five positions, the contiguous-read form differing as control
- `test_vkd_ple_bf16_cvt` - PleBf16Cvt stores each bf16 element as the half of its widened value bit for bit over 1030 elements, saturating past-range values at 65504 and leaving the words past the count untouched
- `test_vkd_router_gemv_cols` - The router GEMV over 3, 8 and 12 x rows as columns equals the one-row dispatch bit for bit on the f32, bf16 and odd-dim bf16 halfword stamps, with and without fused rms, and the CPU dot within its envelope bar
- `test_vkd_moe_routing` - The resident MoE routing kernels match CPU oracles: the router GEMM at a layer offset, per-row top-k against moe_select_core, the bucket schedule word for word at 20 and 512 experts, and the combine-folded residual step
- `test_vkd_gemv_lane_rule` - gemv_lanes_per_row returns the pinned lane split per row length from 768 to 8192: the grid and codebook formats, the k-lattice formats, and q8 always the whole subgroup
- `test_vkd_gu_publish_slots` - Re-derived on the CPU, the gate-up shell publish gathers every one of 32 rows exactly once off a slot holding that row at subgroup widths 32 and 64 and every lane split, the row index read as a slot missing
- `test_vkd_upload_batch` - A staging batch lands five pieces at odd and overlapping offsets byte for byte in one submit, and regions past the staging buffer flush mid-bracket or take the chunked path with every byte landing

### test_vulkan_kernels_attn.das

The Vulkan tier's attention classes against their CPU oracles, one cell a class family: decode attention over every codec arm and the f32 mirror, the prefill attention class, the cm2 and KHR flash tiles (plain, windowed, with sinks, gated, softcapped), the batched decode and chunked attention tiles, the h128 coopmat tile and the f16-mirror reader stamps. Skips: every cell without dasVulkan or a Vulkan device; the cm2 arms off a coopmat2 device created in cm2 mode; the KHR arms without KHR cooperative matrices at subgroup 32; the batched decode attention cells on a device under the classes' workgroup footprint; a class rail a device declines.

- `test_vkd_da_attn_rqk` - Decode attention with the Q8_0 or Q8_K requant folded into its store matches the CPU oracle row quantized at 1e-4 relative, unsplit and split, heads of 64, 256 and 512, the two-head slab bit for bit the four-head stamp
- `test_vkd_da_attn` - Decode attention over the f32 mirror matches the CPU oracle at 1e-4 relative on every codec arm path, plus a 4.0 softcap and the gpt-oss sink stamps over f32 and f16 mirrors, whole and split
- `test_vkd_da_attn_shapes` - Decode attention matches the CPU oracle at 1e-4 relative on ragged key groups, a full four-head slab, a short last slab, a 24-word head and two or four rows a dispatch, split arms resubmitted on reset counters
- `test_vkd_at_attn` - The prefill attention class matches the causal CPU oracle within 2e-3 on a partial 8-row tile past a nonzero window base, at head 64 plain and head 256 under the sigmoid gate
- `test_vkd_fa_cm2` - The cm2 flash tile at heads 64 to 512 matches the f16-grid oracle within 2e-3 plain, windowed, with sinks, at a row base past poison lead rows and over a ring, its f16-out twin equal to the f32 stamp converted
- `test_vkd_fa_khr` - The KHR flash tile at heads 64 to 512 matches the f16-grid oracle within 2e-3 plain, windowed, with sinks, at a row base past poison lead rows and over a ring, its f16-out twin equal to the f32 stamp converted
- `test_vkd_fa_cm2_h256_gated` - The cm2 gated h256 flash stamp, q at the head stride and the output under the sigmoid gate, matches the gated oracle within 2e-3 on a partial tile while the ungated oracle misses, its f16 twin within 2e-3
- `test_vkd_fa_khr_h256_gated` - The KHR gated h256 flash stamp matches the gated oracle within 2e-3 on a partial tile and at the 35B-A3B geometry, the ungated oracle missing, its f16 twin within 2e-3 and the slack rows untouched
- `test_vkd_fa_cm2_h256_softcap` - The cm2 h256 softcap flash stamp matches the oracle capped at 50 within 2e-3 on scores that reach the cap, the uncapped oracle missing, its f16-out twin within 2e-3 of the f32 stamp
- `test_vkd_fa_khr_h256_softcap` - The KHR h256 softcap flash stamp matches the oracle capped at 50 within 2e-3 on scores that reach the cap, the uncapped oracle missing, its f16-out twin within 2e-3 of the f32 stamp
- `test_vkd_fa_cm2_h256_9b` - The cm2 gated h256 flash stamp at the 9B geometry, 16 heads over 4 kv and 512 rows from position 0, matches the gated oracle within 2e-3, the ungated oracle missing
- `test_vkd_da_attn_b_row0` - The 8-row, wide and h128 batched decode attention tiles at a row base three rows in match the CPU oracle, the lead rows and the two trailing segment rows left at their NaN sentinel
- `test_vkd_da_attn_b` - The 8-row batched decode attention over offset mirrors matches the CPU oracle within 2e-3 at heads 32, 128 and 256 on a partial tile, and under a 4.0 softcap that moves the uncapped rows
- `test_vkd_da_attn_bw` - The wide-head batched decode attention at heads 384 and 512 over offset mirrors matches the CPU oracle within 2e-3, one arm under a 24-position window, its f16-mirror twin beside every arm
- `test_vkd_da_attn_b_ring` - The 8-row, wide and h128 chunked attention tiles reading a 192-row ring under a 40-position window match the oracle over flat positions, and the same rows read a position a row miss it
- `test_vkd_da_attn_b_h128` - The h128 coopmat attention tile matches the CPU oracle at the coopmat bar over two q tiles, and under a 40-key window, a 0.5 softcap and both, the unmasked uncapped oracle missing each
- `test_vkd_da_attn_b_gated` - Gated chunked attention, q at the head [q | gate] stride and the output under the gate sigmoid, matches the gated oracle on the 8-row, wide, wide-f16 and h128 tiles while the ungated oracle misses
- `test_vkd_kv16_readers` - The f16-mirror reader stamps match the CPU oracle: decode attention on every codec arm path and heads 64 to 512 at 1e-4 relative, the batched tile within 2e-3, the h128 coopmat twin at the coopmat bar

### test_vulkan_kernels_gemm.das

The Vulkan tier's GEMM tile families against their CPU oracles, one cell a class family: the f16 GEMMs on the cm2 tile and on KHR fragments, the sdot4 and per-32 batch tiles over every kq leaf format, the coopmat batch variants, the KHR tile and the staged KHR tile over a file's f32 rows, the cm2 l, m, s and e stamps over q8 and every K-quant, IQ, MXFP4 and NVFP4 format, the split-k chunks and the reduce, and the resolved coopmat default ladder with the tile and split picks. Skips: every cell without dasVulkan or a Vulkan device; the cm2 arms off a coopmat2 device created in cm2 mode; the KHR arms without KHR cooperative matrices at subgroup 32; the tile-pick cell where DASLLAMA_CM2_TILE or DASLLAMA_CM2_SPLITK forces the pick; a class rail a device declines.

- `test_vkd_f16_gemm` - The small f16 GEMM on the cm2 tile, direct and eight-chunk split-k through the reduce, matches the f32 dot of the same halves within 2e-5 of the max at four shapes, the header under the base left intact
- `test_vkd_f16_gemm_s` - The cm2 f16 GEMM s column F16GemmCm2S matches the f32 dot of the same halves and the m column stamp bit for bit, on the case body the CUDA s-column cell shares
- `test_vkd_f16_gemm_khr` - The small f16 GEMM on KHR fragments matches the f32 dot of the same halves within 2e-5 of the max at five shapes, rows and d off the 16-row fragment among them, the header under the base intact
- `test_vkd_q8_batch_tile` - The q8 sdot4 batch tile over two regions with an edge column tile, edge row tiles and a zero-filled K tail matches the q8 GEMM oracle within 2e-3
- `test_vkd_kq_batch_family` - The sdot4 kq batch tile of all fifteen kq leaf formats over two regions with edge tiles at two superblocks matches the kq GEMM oracle within 2e-3
- `test_vkd_blk32_batch_family` - The per-32 batch tile for q51, iq4nl32, q4032, q5032 and mx4 over two regions with edge tiles and a K tail matches the engine scalar dots (blk32_gemm_oracle) within 2e-3
- `test_vkd_cm_batch_family` - Each q8 coopmat batch variant the device coopmat mode routes (cmf16, cmi8, the mm L, aligned-L and M tiles) matches the q8 GEMM oracle at the coopmat bar, 2e-2 relative or 4e-3 of the peak
- `test_vkd_kq_q40_cm_batch` - In f16 coopmat mode the q40 cmf16 batch tile over two regions with edge tiles matches the kq GEMM oracle at the coopmat bar, 2e-2 relative or 4e-3 of the peak
- `test_vkd_q8_khr_batch` - The KHR q8 tile at K 576 matches the f16 q8 oracle at the coopmat bar over two regions past sentinel schedule words, and whole and split into 512 and 64 deep k chunks through the reduce
- `test_vkd_f32_khr_batch` - The staged KHR tile over f32 rows rounded to f16 on the stage matches the f16-rounding oracle at the coopmat bar over one region, whole through the reduce and in two k chunks
- `test_vkd_cm2l_batch` - The cm2 l tile over q8 planes at K 576, past sentinel schedule words, matches the f16 q8 oracle at the coopmat bar, 2e-2 relative or 4e-3 of the peak
- `test_vkd_cm2_decode_vector_pair` - The q8 cm2 l-tile toy stamp built with the four-wide decode stripped to the scalar callback and built as the device builds it both match one f16 q8 oracle at the coopmat bar
- `test_vkd_k4_cm2_batch` - The Q4_K cm2 l, m, s and e tiles and the KHR tile, decoding in the load, match the format CPU oracle at the coopmat bar over two regions with sentinel schedule words past the end
- `test_vkd_k5_cm2_batch` - The Q5_K cm2 l, m, s and e tiles and the KHR tile, composing the fifth bit in the load, match the format CPU oracle at the coopmat bar over two regions with sentinel schedule words past the end
- `test_vkd_q51_cm2_batch` - The Q5_1 per-32 cm2 l, m, s and e tiles and the KHR tile, reading the plane verbatim as d times q plus m, match the format CPU oracle at the coopmat bar over two regions
- `test_vkd_iq4nl32_cm2_batch` - The IQ4_NL per-32 cm2 l, m, s and e tiles and the KHR tile, d times the codebook entry off a half-word d, match the format CPU oracle at the coopmat bar over two regions
- `test_vkd_q4032_cm2_batch` - The Q4_0 per-32 cm2 l, m, s and e tiles and the KHR tile, d times nibble minus 8 off a half-word d, match the format CPU oracle at the coopmat bar over two regions
- `test_vkd_q5032_cm2_batch` - The Q5_0 per-32 cm2 l, m, s and e tiles and the KHR tile, d times q minus 16 with the qh fifth bit, match the format CPU oracle at the coopmat bar over two regions
- `test_vkd_mx4_cm2_batch` - The MXFP4 cm2 s and e tiles and the KHR tile, e2m1 nibbles under the halved E8M0 scale with every code reached, match the format CPU oracle at the coopmat bar over two regions
- `test_vkd_q40_cm2_batch` - The Q4_0 superblock-form cm2 l, m, s and e tiles and the KHR tile, decoding the per-block f16 d in the load, match the format CPU oracle at the coopmat bar over two regions
- `test_vkd_k2_cm2_batch` - The Q2_K cm2 l, m, s and e tiles and the KHR tile, decoding the pair-byte nibble scales in the load, match the format CPU oracle at the coopmat bar over two regions
- `test_vkd_iq4nl_cm2_batch` - The IQ4_NL cm2 l, m, s and e tiles and the KHR tile, codebook plus per-block f16 d decoded in the load, match the format CPU oracle at the coopmat bar over two regions
- `test_vkd_nv4_cm2_batch` - The NVFP4 cm2 l, m, s and e tiles and the KHR tile, doubled e2m1 codes under UE4M3 sub-block scales decoded in the load, match the format CPU oracle at the coopmat bar over two regions
- `test_vkd_iq4xs_cm2_batch` - The IQ4_XS cm2 l, m, s and e tiles and the KHR tile, with the codebook staged in workgroup memory, match the format CPU oracle at the coopmat bar over two regions
- `test_vkd_iq3s4_cm2_batch` - The iq3s4 cm2 l, m, s and e tiles and the KHR tile match the format CPU oracle at the coopmat bar over two regions, and the iq4xs oracle reads the same planes apart as control
- `test_vkd_k3_cm2_batch` - The Q3_K cm2 l, m, s and e tiles and the KHR tile, composing the 2-bit quants and hmask in the load, match the format CPU oracle at the coopmat bar over two regions
- `test_vkd_iq3s_cm2_batch` - The IQ3_S cm2 l, m, s and e tiles and the KHR tile, the grid staged in workgroup memory, match the format CPU oracle at the coopmat bar, and the iq3xxs oracle reads the planes apart
- `test_vkd_iq2s_cm2_batch` - The IQ2_S cm2 l, m, s and e tiles and the KHR tile, the u64 grid staged in workgroup memory, match the format CPU oracle at the coopmat bar over two regions
- `test_vkd_iq2xs_cm2_batch` - The IQ2_XS cm2 l, m, s and e tiles and the KHR tile, u64 grid and ksigns by parity decoded in the load, match the format CPU oracle at the coopmat bar over two regions
- `test_vkd_iq2xxs_cm2_batch` - The IQ2_XXS cm2 l, m, s and e tiles and the KHR tile, byte grid and aux32 ksigns decoded in the load, match the format CPU oracle at the coopmat bar over two regions
- `test_vkd_iq3xxs_cm2_batch` - The IQ3_XXS cm2 l, m, s and e tiles and the KHR tile, halved grid and parity signs decoded in the load, match the format CPU oracle at the coopmat bar, and the iq2xxs oracle reads the planes apart
- `test_vkd_k6_cm2_batch` - The Q6_K cm2 l, m, s and e tiles and the KHR tile, composing the 6-bit quants in the load, match the format CPU oracle at the coopmat bar over two regions
- `test_vkd_cm2m_batch` - The cm2 m tile over q8 planes at K 576, past sentinel schedule words, matches the f16 q8 oracle at the coopmat bar, 2e-2 relative or 4e-3 of the peak
- `test_vkd_cm2e_batch` - The cm2 expert e column over q8 planes at K 544, off the 64-deep k grid so the padded edge path runs, matches the f16 q8 oracle at the coopmat bar
- `test_vkd_cm2s_batch` - The cm2 s tile over q8 planes at K 544, off the 64-deep k grid so the padded edge path runs, matches the f16 q8 oracle at the coopmat bar
- `test_vkd_cm2s_short_split` - The cm2 s column split along K into 256-aligned chunks plus the reduce matches the oracle at the coopmat bar under 32 rows for q8 and every per-format tile row, rows past the window keeping sentinel
- `test_vkd_cm2l_split` - The cm2 l tile split at K 1536 of 2816 into two partial planes and summed by the reduce matches the f16 q8 oracle at the coopmat bar over one 300 by 160 region with edge tiles
- `test_vk_coopmat_default_and_tile_pick` - The resolved coopmat default ladder (cm2, mm, sdot4, wave64 off) and the cm2 tile, split-k, decode attention split and FFN slice picks return their pinned values per shape and SM count

### test_vulkan_kv_codec_kernels.das

The Vulkan K/V mirror's quant codecs against the CPU cache's own codec (a Vulkan device, else the cells skip): the stores' bytes against `kv_store_row`, every byte outside the stored rows left at its fill; the decode attention's codec stamps against the CPU attention over the rows `kv_load_row` reads back, on every path the pass has; the f16 shadow pass against those rows rounded to half, bit for bit; tq4's un-rotation against `tq4_unrotate_batch`.

- `test_vkc_q8_store` - The q8_0 K/V store writes the CPU cache codec bytes bit for bit at token rows over two regions and at window rows off an odd layer base, other bytes left at fill, a past-half-range scale clamped
- `test_vkc_tq4_store` - The tq4 K/V store rotates q in place and stores K and V bit for bit as the CPU rotation and tq4 codec at heads of 32 to 512, token and window rows, and a shared-KV dispatch that stores nothing
- `test_vkc_q8_da_attn` - The decode attention q8_0 codec stamps match the CPU attention over the dequantized mirror rows within 1e-4 relative on every path of the pass, the oracle over the unquantized rows missing
- `test_vkc_tq4_da_attn` - The decode attention tq4 codec stamps match the CPU attention over the dequantized rotated rows within 1e-4 relative on every path of the pass, the oracle over the unrotated query missing
- `test_vkc_shadow` - The q8_0 and tq4 mirror f16 shadow passes equal the CPU dequant rounded to half and clamped at 65504 bit for bit, the rows outside the pass left at their NaN sentinel
- `test_vkc_tq4_unrot` - The tq4 un-rotation kernel equals tq4_unrotate_batch bit for bit at heads of 32, 64 and 512, and under the sigmoid head gate at 128 within 2e-3, the ungated rows missing as control

### test_vulkan_mint.das

the forced-feed form a routed carrier's lanes are held to: the prompt's row and `MINT_STEPS` fed steps' rows on a session of `tr`, the same tokens fed on every lane, so two lanes compare row by row at the routed block's bar with the row one step off the control, where a greedy token can flip on a near-tie expert

- `test_vulkan_mint_lanes` - A cold Vulkan-armed load of Qwen3.5-0.8B-MTP mints the Vulkan lane alone; the trimmed lane, a smaller file, serves the untrimmed lane greedy tokens exactly and its CPU embed row bit for bit, cold and warm
- `test_vulkan_mint_moe_streamed` - Qwen1.5-MoE with twenty routed layers streamed to the host: the trimmed lane drops the planar families and its fed logit rows hold the routed-block bar against the untrimmed lane, cold and warm, through the rare rail
- `test_vulkan_mint_kquant` - The Qwen3.5-0.8B Q4_K_M lane mints off its native K-quant planes with the plan, and its warm map onto the whole-model driver serves the cold mint tokens exactly and the same embed row bit for bit
- `test_vulkan_mint_trim_follows_the_driver` - The trim admits exactly what the whole-model driver serves: a foreign prefill override declines both with one text, keeps the trimmed lane on disk while serving planar, and lifting it mints the trimmed lane again
- `test_vulkan_mint_trim_refused_unarmed` - Under an injected resident upload fault a trimmed lane is refused at load with a panic naming the lane file and the decline, the file left as minted, while the same load with the driver armed serves
- `test_vulkan_mint_failed_write_leaves_nothing` - A lane mint whose write the fault seam fails publishes no lane and leaves no temp file, yet the load serves from memory; with the seam off the next load mints the lane the driver serves
- `test_vulkan_mint_kv_codecs` - A trimmed lane minted under a q8_0 K/V mirror maps unchanged under tq4 and f16 and serves at each codec the staged load greedy tokens exactly, the codecs shown to move the tokens apart

### test_vulkan_moe_cm2.das

- `test_vulkan_moe_cm2_chain` - The cm2 expert chain (k4 gate and up, k6 down, f16 feed) matches an f16-rounding CPU reference within 4e-3 of the row max over two-region routings: small, a region ending mid-tile, and a 2048-wide multi-tile
- `test_vulkan_moe_cm2_one_region` - The cm2 expert chain in the shared expert call shape, one region over every position with the identity slot map at unit weight, matches the CPU reference within 4e-3 of the row max at 512 and 2048 wide
- `test_vulkan_moe_cm2_streamed` - The cm2 expert chain over streamed stacks, through the slot rebase and the timeline hand-off, matches the f16-rounding CPU reference within 4e-3 of the row max on two activation windows
- `test_vulkan_moe_cm2_split` - The cm2 chain async begin and join over a region head (resident, one streamed expert, and two streamed experts through the ring) matches the CPU reference with the other slots at zero weight, within 4e-3 of the row max

### test_vulkan_shared_device.das

- `test_vk_one_device_a_process` - A worker thread's context borrows the device this context made, holds one extra reference while alive, sees this context's held bytes cut from its room and resident cap, and returns the reference at shutdown
- `test_vk_shared_queue_submits` - One more worker context than the device has compute queues takes every queue round robin, two contexts share one, and every upload-readback round trip returns its bytes exactly
- `test_vk_device_queue_ask` - `device_queue_count` answers the `set_device_queue_ask` ask clamped to at least one and at most the family's queue count, and one queue for a family past the device's
- `test_vk_shared_queue_under_validation` - The shared-queue cell rerun in a child under the Khronos validation layer passes with zero UNASSIGNED-Threading errors: every submit and wait on a shared queue holds its lock
- `test_vk_last_context_out` - The last context out destroys the device, clears the holder and its byte count; the next context makes a fresh device with one reference and serves on it, after volkFinalize too
- `test_vk_validation_last_context_out` - The lifecycle cell rerun under the Khronos validation layer passes with no VUID-vkDestroy error, and the loader unloads the layer as often as it inserted it across the cell's three instances

### test_vulkan_tier.das

- `test_vulkan_one_shot_command` - The shared one-shot command submits and retires an empty chain on a tier nothing engaged, and again after `moe_gpu_drop_model_state` freed every model-owned command, leaving zero VRAM held
- `test_vulkan_moe_ffn_vs_ref` - The Vulkan q8 MoE fused FFN matches the CPU dequant reference within 1e-3 of its max on decode GEMV and 40-row batch shapes, and the device combine matches a CPU combine of its own rows, across two 8192-row chunks too
- `test_vulkan_moe_ffn_streamed` - Three streamed q8 FFN layers dispatched in runtime order 2,1,0,2 through two pinned slots (cold copy, prefetch hit, rotation, eviction reload) each match the CPU reference within 1e-3 of its max
- `test_vulkan_moe_heat_cache` - The two-slot heat cache reports the hit mask of the pinned expert set, its async begin/join hit dispatch matches the CPU reference within 1e-3 of max, and a re-pin evicts and re-uploads so the new hit matches too
- `test_vulkan_moe_ffn_kq` - The native K-quant MoE FFN (k4 gate/up with a k6 then a k5 down, two superblocks a row) matches the dequantized CPU reference within 1e-3 of max on decode and batch shapes, and the k6 classifier GEMV over two recorded resubmits
- `test_vulkan_moe_ffn_q40` - An all-Q4_0 MoE FFN triple matches the dequantized CPU reference within 1e-3 of max through the GEMV kernel and the q40 batch tile, catching a sign error in the implicit -8 fold
- `test_vulkan_moe_ffn_mixed` - A mixed k4 gate/up with q8 down MoE FFN requants the hidden row in Q8_0 and matches the CPU reference within 1e-3 of max on both the decode GEMV and the batch path
- `test_vulkan_dense_gemm` - The one-region dense GEMM rail matches a double-accumulated CPU GEMM within 1e-3 of max for q8 and k4 planes over 40 unpadded rows, and after `moe_gpu_drop_stacks` rolls back a later upload the earlier stack and the re-uploaded offset still serve
- `test_vulkan_deltanet` - The Vulkan deltanet chain's out rows, final state (3e-3 of max) and conv tail (1e-3) match a CPU mirror of the chunked delta rule at 70 positions across the 64-chunk boundary and 1100 across the 1024-row window
- `test_vulkan_deltanet_two_forms` - A deltanet chain with a q8 qkv plane fed Q8_0 and a k4 z plane fed Q8_K through the second image matches the CPU chain within 3e-3 of max at 70 and 1 rows, and misses it when z is fed the Q8_0 image (the control)
- `test_vulkan_deltanet_step` - Eight one-token deltanet decode steps with device-resident state, flushed and cold re-uploaded at token 4, match the straight-through CPU mirror's out rows, state and conv ring, the token-4 flush included
- `test_vulkan_attention` - The Vulkan full-attention chain's out, roped K and V rows match a straight-softmax CPU mirror within 5e-3 of max across gated partial rope, ungated full rope, a k4 wo, projection bias, and a 1100-position multi-window arm
- `test_vulkan_rope_kv_store` - `vk_rope_kv_store` ropes q and the stored K row like the engine's table rope within 1e-3 of max plus 1e-6, and stores V unchanged, in both the NORM (llama) and NEOX pair layouts
- `test_vulkan_decode_attn` - `vk_decode_attn` over a device KV mirror filled by five `vk_rope_kv_store` steps matches a CPU GQA softmax attention over the captured rows within 1e-3 of max plus 1e-5
- `test_vulkan_arena_gemm` - The arena batch GEMM over 40 rows matches the double-accumulated CPU q8 GEMM within 1e-3 of max for two arena-resident tensors, so the second tensor's block offset is honored
- `test_vulkan_arena_ffn` - The one-submit arena dense FFN (gate and up GEMV, fused silu requant, down GEMV) over an arena-placed q8 triple matches the CPU fused-FFN reference within 1e-3 of max
- `test_vulkan_add_rms` - `vk_add_rms` matches a double CPU RMSNorm within 1e-3 of max on the fused add arm (ascale 0.75, non-zero addend) and the norm-only arm, and writes the scaled residual back into x, which y alone cannot show
- `test_vulkan_arena` - The resident arena packs two q8 tensors back to back by block count, and the arena GEMV over each matches the CPU q8 reference within 1e-3 of max, so the block offset is honored
- `test_vulkan_drop_model` - Two drop and re-arm cycles uploading different content at the same stack offset and arena each serve their own cycle's CPU reference within 1e-3 of max, and each whole-model drop leaves zero resident VRAM
- `test_vulkan_arena_slabs` - Under a forced 2.5-tensor slab cap, the third arena placement starts slab 1 at local block 0 (block 1 shl 32) after two in slab 0, and the GEMV over all three matches the CPU q8 reference

### test_vulkan_tower_kernels.das

The vision and audio towers' Vulkan kernel classes against their CPU oracles (a Vulkan device, else the cells skip): the bidirectional flash tiles, the tower row classes, the Conformer and FastConformer classes, the biased-block classes and their f16-feed stamps, the whisper decoder's classes, the padded attention route, the window classes, the audio fronts' data movers and spectral classes, and canary's rel-plane attention.

- `test_vkt_fa_bidir` - The bidirectional flash tile (cm2 and KHR, h64 and h128) over 77 rows matches the all-keys CPU attention at the 2e-3 approx bar, keeps sentinel slack rows past kvlen masked, and differs from its causal twin on row 0 only
- `test_vkt_wdec_fused_rq` - The layernorm, post-add, bias-GELU and attention combine fused with the Q8_0 requant land the separate pass's Q8_0 bytes and scales exactly at widths 256, 384 and 1280, and their rows match the CPU forms at the approx bar
- `test_vkt_tile_rows` - `vt_tile_rows` rounds a GEMM record's rows up to a whole 256-wide l column (1500 to 1536, 1152 to 1280) and leaves the raw count for the m and s columns and the q8 batch tile
- `test_vkt_tower_rows` - The tower row classes match the CPU tower helpers over 37 rows: clamp, clamp copy (source untouched) and the f16 clamp feed bit for bit, rope2d and geglu at the approx bar, plus the shared rms, post-add, clamp+rq and plain post-add cases
- `test_vkt_tower_vision_rows` - The vision stem and tail stamps match the CPU forms: patch im2col with the [-1, 1] map and zero pad rows, the 2-axis position add and the qwen3v merge-walk assemble bit for bit, grid mean pool and affine rows at the approx bar
- `test_vkt_tower_tail_rows` - The chat projector tails' row-pair mean pool and swapped SwiGLU at an off-multiple width of 70 match the CPU forms at the approx bar with idle lanes untouched, and the unswapped gate lands elsewhere
- `test_vkt_tower_conformer` - The Conformer stamps (silu, GLU, causal depthwise taps, windowed RPE attention at head widths 64 and 128) match the CPU loops at the approx bar; scaled keys and a 4x softcap oracle land elsewhere, proving the cap engages
- `test_vkt_tower_fastconformer` - The FastConformer conv tail (centered depthwise conv, folded BatchNorm, silu) on channel-major and tap-major taps, and gigaam's biased form, match the CPU loop at the approx bar with poison past npos never read
- `test_vkt_tower_ga_dwh` - Gigaam's f16-tap depthwise conv matches the CPU loop over the same halfwords within 1e-6 relative at k5 and k31, that loop is bit-exact to the f32 loop, and a poisoned halfword tap reds the bar
- `test_vkt_tower_dw2d` - Parakeet's k3 s2 p1 depthwise conv2d over tap-major taps matches the CPU loop at the approx bar, unmasked and under a valid-length mask that measurably changes the rows, idle lanes untouched
- `test_vkt_tower_ln_rows` - The biased-block classes match the CPU helpers: layernorm, five bias-activations (erf GELU at 1e-5, told apart from tanh), post-add+ln with its ln_on 0 and ascale 0.5 seams, exact head pad/unpad with zero tails, and the k-slot rope
- `test_vkt_tower_f16_feeds` - Each f16-feed stamp is its f32 twin rounded to half bit for bit: bias_act_cvt16 on three activations, the biased head pads with zero tails, hunpad16, and the ln16 and post_add_ln16 halves, which also hold the layernorm bar
- `test_vkt_wdec_classes` - The whisper decoder's K/V store writes its F16, KX and VX layouts bit for bit as the CPU chain, and the chunked attention pair matches the CPU form at the approx bar on causal rows across a chunk boundary and on cross rows
- `test_vkt_tower_padded_attn` - The padded attention route (pad 72-wide heads to 128, the h128 bidirectional flash tile, unpad) over sixteen heads and 77 rows matches `attention_bidir` at the 2e-3 approx bar
- `test_vkt_tower_win_rows` - The window-attention class over 982 rows in sixteen windows, one ragged, matches `attention_bidir_windows` at the approx bar while full attention lands elsewhere; the f16 gated hidden and the rms seam match their CPU forms
- `test_vkt_tower_front_movers` - The audio fronts' data movers reproduce their CPU forms: im2col and shuffles as exact halves, one-head restrides with and without bias, clamp+halfword, the exact plane add touching nothing past it, and the qwen3a finish's bias and position rows
- `test_vkt_tower_front_mel` - The audio fronts' spectral classes match their CPU forms at the approx bar: the DFT magnitude and power arms, three mel-log floor laws, canary's mel normalization with an exact zero tail, depthwise conv and the rel sin-cos table
- `test_vkt_tower_ga_mel` - Gigaam's device front writes the windowed frames with their zero pads bit for bit, and its clamped-log mel matches the CPU form within 1e-6, a zero frame reading the floor's log and a loud one the ceiling's
- `test_vkt_tower_cn_attn_rel_plane` - Canary's rel-plane FastConformer attention over four 64-wide and two 128-wide heads matches the CPU rel-pos loop with u/v biases at the approx bar; scaled keys and a scaled rel table each land elsewhere
- `test_vkt_tower_vad` - The silero VAD encoder over three chunks and its LSTM recurrence at one and five chunks from a nonzero state match the `_vad_oracle` references at the approx bar, the state moving off its input
- `test_vkt_rnnt` - The transducer decode's gates, predictor projection, joint window and pick stamps match the `_rnnt_oracle` references on the Metal cells' legs at both fixture shapes, including states that must leave outputs untouched
- `test_vkt_ctc_pick` - The CTC pick writes every row's record with the CPU loop's exact class (a tie taking the lower class, an all-NaN row class 0) and each plog within 1e-5 relative, and a poisoned bias element moves the plogs
- `test_vkt_nmt` - The Bergamot step's embed rows bit for bit, SSRU cell within 1e-6 relative with layer 0 kept, and greedy pick records exact at vocabularies 200, 1000 and 32000 match the `_nmt_oracle` references, each with a poisoned-input control
- `test_vkt_nmt_attn` - The Bergamot attention part+combine pair at head widths 32, 48 and 64 over 300 keys (two chunks) and 150 matches `wdec_attn_ref` at the approx bar with the K/V run behind a lead, slack kept, doubled key scale landing elsewhere

The TTS tower's sequence classes on Vulkan against the CPU chain (a Vulkan device, else the cells skip; the half im2col cell also skips where the device serves no f16 tile): the conv im2col in both directions, fed through F32GemmB and held to the CPU `conv1d` end to end, the half im2col through the f16 tile and the bias pass, one LSTM direction held to the CPU `bilstm` on both walks, and the depthwise transposed pool held to its CPU rows form, at channel and hidden widths off every lattice, with the poisoned-element control on every compare.

- `test_vkt_tts_im2col16` - The half im2col through the f16 GEMM tile plus the bias pass matches the CPU `conv1d` at the approx bar on f16-exact operands, for a forward k5, a transposed k4 s2 and a forward k3 over row-major x
- `test_vkt_tts_im2col` - The f32 conv im2col fed through F32GemmB matches the CPU `conv1d` at the approx bar for a forward k5 conv, a transposed k4 s2 conv and a forward conv off row-major x, at element offsets, with poisoned slab pad columns kept out
- `test_vkt_tts_lstm_dir` - The LSTM direction stamp at hidden 64 and 200 over 23 steps reproduces the CPU `bilstm` at the approx bar for both directions into one row set and for the forward weights walked backward, and flipping `backward` moves the output
- `test_vkt_tts_pool_dw` - The depthwise transposed pool k3 s2 p1 with output padding over 22 channels and 19 steps produces 38 rows matching `conv1d_rows_transposed_depthwise` at the approx bar, reading weights and bias between poisoned slots

### test_vulkan_tts_kernels.das

The TTS tower's Vulkan kernel classes against their CPU oracles (a Vulkan device, else the cells skip): the f32-exact tile GEMM the front end feeds on, in both its stamps, at shapes off every tile and workgroup multiple, and the PL-BERT seat's row classes - the embedding gather, the tanh GELU, the leaky ReLU and the bidirectional attention - and the predictor and decoder row classes - the concat, the duration sigmoid sums, the column statistics with the fused AdaIN stamps and the residual join - with the poisoned-element control on every compare.

- `test_vkt_f32_gemm` - The f32 tile GEMM, plain and biased, at 37 x 100 x 96 off every tile multiple matches the k-ordered sum at the approx bar, stores every output element, and never reads the poisoned slab pad past n
- `test_vkt_row_gather` - The embedding gather at element bases off zero equals the CPU word + position + type sum bit for bit, with neither add, each add alone and both, follows its ids, and leaves the prefix before out_off at its sentinel
- `test_vkt_gelu_tanh` - The tanh GELU over a 5203-element run at an offset matches the CPU `gelu` within 1e-5 relative, inputs at +-30 past the tanh clamp included, leaves the outside untouched, and the bar tells it from the f16 LUT form
- `test_vkt_leaky` - The leaky ReLU over a 5203-element run at an offset equals the CPU `leaky_relu` bit for bit at slope 0.2, the three-element tail included, with the elements outside the run untouched
- `test_vkt_attn` - The TTS bidirectional attention matches the CPU `attention_rows` within 1e-5 relative at 37x4x64, 130x2x128 and 512x2x64 (two keys an invocation), and zeroing the last key moves the first query row, so every key is read
- `test_vkt_concat` - The concat rows equal the CPU concat bit for bit with one broadcast style row, and with the f0 and noise columns read at their row strides plus a zero pad to width 48
- `test_vkt_sigsum` - The duration sigmoid sums over the first 50 of 64 logit columns at speed 1.3 match the CPU raw durations at the approx bar, with the poisoned columns past nb kept out of the sum
- `test_vkt_colstats` - The four-pass column statistics match the double-precision channel means and squared deviations at the approx bar at 45x72, 300x20 (a short last block) and 1000x300 (lanes taking two channels)
- `test_vkt_adain` - The fused AdaIN stamps over device column stats match the CPU `adain_rows_into` plus leaky ReLU or Snake at the approx bar, and the in-place leaky stamp equals the out-of-place one bit for bit with the slack untouched
- `test_vkt_add_scale` - The residual add-and-scale equals (a + b) / sqrt(2) in f32 bit for bit over 1030 elements, out of place and in place, with the elements past the run left as they were

### test_vulkan_tts_pocket_kernels.das

The Pocket TTS family's Vulkan classes against the CPU chain (a Vulkan device, else the cells skip): the codec stream's row copies with and without the ELU, the layer scale, the causal cached attention row over the caches' rows, the row GEMV's five stamps and the frame loop's four fused stamps, and the rows rope; every written-only output under a NaN fill, every compare with its poisoned element.

- `test_vkt_pk_rows` - The Pocket row copy writes a 7 x 13 strided window bit for bit and its ELU twin matches `elu_rows` at the approx bar, moving only the negative elements, with every element outside the window left at its sentinel
- `test_vkt_pk_row_scale` - The in-place layer scale over 37 x 72 rows with the scale row at an offset equals the CPU `layer_scale_rows` bit for bit, leaving the slack past the rows untouched
